  66 |     |     //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
  67 |     | 
  68 |     |     function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) public virtual returns (bool) {
  69 |     |         allowance[msg.sender][spender] = amount;
  70 |     | 
  71 |     |         emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, amount);
  72 |     | 
  73 |     |         return true;
  74 |     |     }
  75 |     | 
  76 |     |     function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) public virtual returns (bool) {
  77 |     |         balanceOf[msg.sender] -= amount;
  78 |     | 
  79 |     |         // Cannot overflow because the sum of all user
  80 |     |         // balances can't exceed the max uint256 value.
  81 |     |         unchecked {
  82 |     |             balanceOf[to] += amount;
  83 |     |         }
  84 |     | 
  85 |     |         emit Transfer(msg.sender, to, amount);
  86 |     | 
  87 |     |         return true;
  88 |     |     }
  89 |     | 
  90 |     |     function transferFrom(
  91 |     |         address from,
  92 |     |         address to,
  93 |     |         uint256 amount
  94 |     |     ) public virtual returns (bool) {
  95 |     |         uint256 allowed = allowance[from][msg.sender]; // Saves gas for limited approvals.
  96 |     | 
  97 |     |         if (allowed != type(uint256).max) allowance[from][msg.sender] = allowed - amount;
  98 |     | 
  99 |     |         balanceOf[from] -= amount;
 100 |     | 
 101 |     |         // Cannot overflow because the sum of all user
 102 |     |         // balances can't exceed the max uint256 value.
 103 |     |         unchecked {
 104 |     |             balanceOf[to] += amount;
 105 |     |         }
 106 |     | 
 107 |     |         emit Transfer(from, to, amount);
 108 |     | 
 109 |     |         return true;
 110 |     |     }
 111 |     | 
 112 |     |     /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
 113 |     |                              EIP-2612 LOGIC
 114 |     |     //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
 115 |     | 
 116 |     |     function permit(
 117 |     |         address owner,
 118 |     |         address spender,
 119 |     |         uint256 value,
 120 |     |         uint256 deadline,
 121 |     |         uint8 v,
 122 |     |         bytes32 r,
 123 |     |         bytes32 s
 124 |     |     ) public virtual {
 125 |     |         require(deadline >= block.timestamp, "PERMIT_DEADLINE_EXPIRED");
 126 |     | 
 127 |     |         // Unchecked because the only math done is incrementing
 128 |     |         // the owner's nonce which cannot realistically overflow.
 129 |     |         unchecked {
 130 |     |             address recoveredAddress = ecrecover(
 131 |     |                 keccak256(
 132 |     |                     abi.encodePacked(
 133 |     |                         "\x19\x01",
 134 |     |                         DOMAIN_SEPARATOR(),
 135 |     |                         keccak256(
 136 |     |                             abi.encode(
 137 |     |                                 keccak256(
 138 |     |                                     "Permit(address owner,address spender,uint256 value,uint256 nonce,uint256 deadline)"
 139 |     |                                 ),
 140 |     |                                 owner,
 141 |     |                                 spender,
 142 |     |                                 value,
 143 |     |                                 nonces[owner]++,
 144 |     |                                 deadline
 145 |     |                             )
 146 |     |                         )
 147 |     |                     )
 148 |     |                 ),
 149 |     |                 v,
 150 |     |                 r,
 151 |     |                 s
 152 |     |             );
 153 |     | 
 154 |     |             require(recoveredAddress != address(0) && recoveredAddress == owner, "INVALID_SIGNER");
 155 |     | 
 156 |     |             allowance[recoveredAddress][spender] = value;
 157 |     |         }
 158 |     | 
 159 |     |         emit Approval(owner, spender, value);
 160 |     |     }
 161 |     | 
 162 |     |     function DOMAIN_SEPARATOR() public view virtual returns (bytes32) {
 163 |     |         return block.chainid == INITIAL_CHAIN_ID ? INITIAL_DOMAIN_SEPARATOR : computeDomainSeparator();
 164 |     |     }
 165 |     | 
 166 |     |     function computeDomainSeparator() internal view virtual returns (bytes32) {
 167 |     |         return
 168 |     |             keccak256(
 169 |     |                 abi.encode(
 170 |     |                     keccak256("EIP712Domain(string name,string version,uint256 chainId,address verifyingContract)"),
 171 |     |                     keccak256(bytes(name)),
 172 |     |                     keccak256("1"),
 173 |     |                     block.chainid,
 174 |     |                     address(this)
 175 |     |                 )
 176 |     |             );
 177 |     |     }
 178 |     | 
 179 |     |     /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
 180 |     |                         INTERNAL MINT/BURN LOGIC
 181 |     |     //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
 182 |     | 
 183 |     |     function _mint(address to, uint256 amount) internal virtual {
 184 |     |         totalSupply += amount;
 185 |     | 
 186 |     |         // Cannot overflow because the sum of all user
 187 |     |         // balances can't exceed the max uint256 value.
 188 |     |         unchecked {
 189 |     |             balanceOf[to] += amount;
 190 |     |         }
 191 |     | 
 192 |     |         emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);
 193 |     |     }
 194 |     | 
 195 |     |     function _burn(address from, uint256 amount) internal virtual {
 196 |     |         balanceOf[from] -= amount;
 197 |     | 
 198 |     |         // Cannot underflow because a user's balance
 199 |     |         // will never be larger than the total supply.
 200 |     |         unchecked {
 201 |     |             totalSupply -= amount;
 202 |     |         }
 203 |     | 
 204 |     |         emit Transfer(from, address(0), amount);
 205 |     |     }

  1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
  2 |     | pragma solidity >=0.6.0;
  3 |     | 
  4 |     | import {IExtsload} from "./interfaces/IExtsload.sol";
  5 |     | 
  6 |     | /// @notice Enables public storage access for efficient state retrieval by external contracts.
  7 |     | /// https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2330#rationale
  8 |     | abstract contract Extsload is IExtsload {
  9 |     |     /// @inheritdoc IExtsload
 10 |     |     function extsload(bytes32 slot) external view returns (bytes32) {
 11 |     |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
 12 |     |             mstore(0, sload(slot))
 13 |     |             return(0, 0x20)
 14 |     |         }
 15 |     |     }
 16 |     | 
 17 |     |     /// @inheritdoc IExtsload
 18 |     |     function extsload(bytes32 startSlot, uint256 nSlots) external view returns (bytes memory) {
 19 |     |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
 20 |     |             // The abi offset of dynamic array in the returndata is 32.
 21 |     |             mstore(0, 0x20)
 22 |     |             // A left bit-shift of 5 is equivalent to multiplying by 32 but costs less gas.
 23 |     |             mstore(0x20, shl(5, nSlots))
 24 |     |             let end := add(0x40, shl(5, nSlots))
 25 |     |             for { let memptr := 0x40 } 1 {} {
 26 |     |                 mstore(memptr, sload(startSlot))
 27 |     |                 memptr := add(memptr, 0x20)
 28 |     |                 startSlot := add(startSlot, 1)
 29 |     |                 if iszero(lt(memptr, end)) { break }
 30 |     |             }
 31 |     |             // The end offset is also the length of the returndata.
 32 |     |             return(0, end)
 33 |     |         }
 34 |     |     }
 35 |     | 
 36 |     |     /// @inheritdoc IExtsload
 37 |     |     function extsload(bytes32[] calldata slots) external view returns (bytes32[] memory) {
 38 |     |         // since the function is external and enters a new call context and exits right
 39 |     |         // after execution, Solidity's memory management convention can be disregarded
 40 |     |         // and a direct slice of memory can be returned
 41 |     |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
 42 |     |             // Copy the abi offset of dynamic array and the length of the array to memory.
 43 |     |             calldatacopy(0, 0x04, 0x40)
 44 |     |             // A left bit-shift of 5 is equivalent to multiplying by 32 but costs less gas.
 45 |     |             let end := add(0x40, shl(5, slots.length))
 46 |     |             let calldataptr := slots.offset
 47 |     |             // Return values will start at 64 while calldata offset is 68.
 48 |     |             for { let memptr := 0x40 } 1 {} {
 49 |     |                 mstore(memptr, sload(calldataload(calldataptr)))
 50 |     |                 memptr := add(memptr, 0x20)
 51 |     |                 calldataptr := add(calldataptr, 0x20)
 52 |     |                 if iszero(lt(memptr, end)) { break }
 53 |     |             }
 54 |     |             // The end offset is also the length of the returndata.
 55 |     |             return(0, end)
 56 |     |         }
 57 |     |     }
 58 |     | }
 59 |     |

  1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
  2 |     | pragma solidity >=0.8.24;
  3 |     | 
  4 |     | import {IExttload} from "./interfaces/IExttload.sol";
  5 |     | 
  6 |     | /// @notice Enables public transient storage access for efficient state retrieval by external contracts.
  7 |     | /// https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2330#rationale
  8 |     | abstract contract Exttload is IExttload {
  9 |     |     /// @inheritdoc IExttload
 10 |     |     function exttload(bytes32 slot) external view returns (bytes32) {
 11 |     |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
 12 |     |             mstore(0, tload(slot))
 13 |     |             return(0, 0x20)
 14 |     |         }
 15 |     |     }
 16 |     | 
 17 |     |     /// @inheritdoc IExttload
 18 |     |     function exttload(bytes32[] calldata slots) external view returns (bytes32[] memory) {
 19 |     |         // since the function is external and enters a new call context and exits right
 20 |     |         // after execution, Solidity's memory management convention can be disregarded
 21 |     |         // and a direct slice of memory can be returned
 22 |     |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
 23 |     |             // Copy the abi offset of dynamic array and the length of the array to memory.
 24 |     |             calldatacopy(0, 0x04, 0x40)
 25 |     |             // A left bit-shift of 5 is equivalent to multiplying by 32 but costs less gas.
 26 |     |             let end := add(0x40, shl(5, slots.length))
 27 |     |             let calldataptr := slots.offset
 28 |     |             // Return values will start at 64 while calldata offset is 68.
 29 |     |             for { let memptr := 0x40 } 1 {} {
 30 |     |                 mstore(memptr, tload(calldataload(calldataptr)))
 31 |     |                 memptr := add(memptr, 0x20)
 32 |     |                 calldataptr := add(calldataptr, 0x20)
 33 |     |                 if iszero(lt(memptr, end)) { break }
 34 |     |             }
 35 |     |             // The end offset is also the length of the returndata.
 36 |     |             return(0, end)
 37 |     |         }
 38 |     |     }
 39 |     | }

  4 |     | import {CustomRevert} from "./libraries/CustomRevert.sol";
  5 |     | 
  6 |     | /// @title Prevents delegatecall to a contract
  7 |     | /// @notice Base contract that provides a modifier for preventing delegatecall to methods in a child contract
  8 |     | abstract contract NoDelegateCall {
  9 |     |     using CustomRevert for bytes4;
 10 |     | 
 11 |     |     error DelegateCallNotAllowed();
 12 |     | 
 13 |     |     /// @dev The original address of this contract
 14 |     |     address private immutable original;
 15 |     | 
 16 |     |     constructor() {
 17 |     |         // Immutables are computed in the init code of the contract, and then inlined into the deployed bytecode.
 18 |     |         // In other words, this variable won't change when it's checked at runtime.
 19 |     |         original = address(this);
 20 |     |     }
 21 |     | 
 22 |     |     /// @dev Private method is used instead of inlining into modifier because modifiers are copied into each method,
 23 |     |     ///     and the use of immutable means the address bytes are copied in every place the modifier is used.
 24 |     |     function checkNotDelegateCall() private view {
 25 |     |         if (address(this) != original) DelegateCallNotAllowed.selector.revertWith();
 26 |     |     }
 27 |     | 
 28 |     |     /// @notice Prevents delegatecall into the modified method
 29 |     |     modifier noDelegateCall() {
 30 |     |         checkNotDelegateCall();
 31 |     |         _;
 32 |     |     }
 33 |     | }

 100 |     |     /// @notice This will revert if the contract is locked

 103 |     |         _;
 104 |     |     }

 106 |     |     /// @inheritdoc IPoolManager
 107 |     |     function unlock(bytes calldata data) external override returns (bytes memory result) {
 108 |     |         if (Lock.isUnlocked()) AlreadyUnlocked.selector.revertWith();
 109 |     | 
 110 |     |         Lock.unlock();
 111 |     | 
 112 |     |         // the caller does everything in this callback, including paying what they owe via calls to settle
 113 |     |         result = IUnlockCallback(msg.sender).unlockCallback(data);
 114 |     | 
 115 |     |         if (NonZeroDeltaCount.read() != 0) CurrencyNotSettled.selector.revertWith();
 116 |     |         Lock.lock();

 119 |     |     /// @inheritdoc IPoolManager
 120 |     |     function initialize(PoolKey memory key, uint160 sqrtPriceX96, bytes calldata hookData)
 121 |     |         external
 122 |     |         override
 123 |     |         noDelegateCall
 124 |     |         returns (int24 tick)
 125 |     |     {
 126 |     |         // see TickBitmap.sol for overflow conditions that can arise from tick spacing being too large
 127 |     |         if (key.tickSpacing > MAX_TICK_SPACING) TickSpacingTooLarge.selector.revertWith();
 128 |     |         if (key.tickSpacing < MIN_TICK_SPACING) TickSpacingTooSmall.selector.revertWith();
 129 |     |         if (key.currency0 >= key.currency1) CurrenciesOutOfOrderOrEqual.selector.revertWith();
 130 |     |         if (!key.hooks.isValidHookAddress(key.fee)) Hooks.HookAddressNotValid.selector.revertWith(address(key.hooks));
 131 |     | 
 132 |     |         uint24 lpFee = key.fee.getInitialLPFee();
 133 |     | 
 134 |     |         key.hooks.beforeInitialize(key, sqrtPriceX96, hookData);
 135 |     |

 137 |     |         (, uint24 protocolFee) = _fetchProtocolFee(key);

 140 |     |

 144 |     |         // the key's fee may be a static fee or a sentinel to denote a dynamic fee.
 145 |     |         emit Initialize(id, key.currency0, key.currency1, key.fee, key.tickSpacing, key.hooks);

 151 |     |         IPoolManager.ModifyLiquidityParams memory params,
 152 |     |         bytes calldata hookData
 153 |     |     ) external override onlyWhenUnlocked noDelegateCall returns (BalanceDelta callerDelta, BalanceDelta feesAccrued) {
 154 |     |         PoolId id = key.toId();
 155 |     |         Pool.State storage pool = _getPool(id);
 156 |     |         pool.checkPoolInitialized();
 157 |     |

 179 |     |

 181 |     |         if (hookDelta != BalanceDeltaLibrary.ZERO_DELTA) _accountPoolBalanceDelta(key, hookDelta, address(key.hooks));
 182 |     |

 186 |     |     /// @inheritdoc IPoolManager
 187 |     |     function swap(PoolKey memory key, IPoolManager.SwapParams memory params, bytes calldata hookData)
 188 |     |         external
 189 |     |         override
 190 |     |         onlyWhenUnlocked
 191 |     |         noDelegateCall
 192 |     |         returns (BalanceDelta swapDelta)
 193 |     |     {
 194 |     |         if (params.amountSpecified == 0) SwapAmountCannotBeZero.selector.revertWith();
 195 |     |         PoolId id = key.toId();
 196 |     |         Pool.State storage pool = _getPool(id);
 197 |     |         pool.checkPoolInitialized();
 198 |     | 
 199 |     |         BeforeSwapDelta beforeSwapDelta;
 200 |     |         {
 201 |     |             int256 amountToSwap;
 202 |     |             uint24 lpFeeOverride;
 203 |     |             (amountToSwap, beforeSwapDelta, lpFeeOverride) = key.hooks.beforeSwap(key, params, hookData);
 204 |     | 
 205 |     |             // execute swap, account protocol fees, and emit swap event
 206 |     |             // _swap is needed to avoid stack too deep error
 207 |     |             swapDelta = _swap(
 208 |     |                 pool,
 209 |     |                 id,
 210 |     |                 Pool.SwapParams({
 211 |     |                     tickSpacing: key.tickSpacing,
 212 |     |                     zeroForOne: params.zeroForOne,
 213 |     |                     amountSpecified: amountToSwap,
 214 |     |                     sqrtPriceLimitX96: params.sqrtPriceLimitX96,
 215 |     |                     lpFeeOverride: lpFeeOverride
 216 |     |                 }),
 217 |     |                 params.zeroForOne ? key.currency0 : key.currency1 // input token
 218 |     |             );
 219 |     |         }
 220 |     | 
 221 |     |         BalanceDelta hookDelta;
 222 |     |         (swapDelta, hookDelta) = key.hooks.afterSwap(key, params, swapDelta, hookData, beforeSwapDelta);
 223 |     | 
 224 |     |         // if the hook doesnt have the flag to be able to return deltas, hookDelta will always be 0
 225 |     |         if (hookDelta != BalanceDeltaLibrary.ZERO_DELTA) _accountPoolBalanceDelta(key, hookDelta, address(key.hooks));
 226 |     | 
 227 |     |         _accountPoolBalanceDelta(key, swapDelta, msg.sender);
 228 |     |     }

 230 |     |     /// @notice Internal swap function to execute a swap, take protocol fees on input token, and emit the swap event
 231 |     |     function _swap(Pool.State storage pool, PoolId id, Pool.SwapParams memory params, Currency inputCurrency)
 232 |     |         internal

 234 |     |     {
 235 |     |         (BalanceDelta delta, uint256 feeForProtocol, uint24 swapFee, Pool.SwapState memory state) = pool.swap(params);
 236 |     |

 239 |     |

 241 |     |         emit Swap(
 242 |     |             id, msg.sender, delta.amount0(), delta.amount1(), state.sqrtPriceX96, state.liquidity, state.tick, swapFee
 243 |     |         );

 322 |     |     /// @notice Adds a balance delta in a currency for a target address
 323 |     |     function _accountDelta(Currency currency, int128 delta, address target) internal {
 324 |     |         if (delta == 0) return;
 325 |     | 
 326 |     |         int256 current = currency.getDelta(target);
 327 |     |         int256 next = current + delta;
 328 |     | 
 329 |     |         if (next == 0) {
 330 |     |             NonZeroDeltaCount.decrement();
 331 |     |         } else if (current == 0) {
 332 |     |             NonZeroDeltaCount.increment();
 333 |     |         }
 334 |     | 
 335 |     |         currency.setDelta(target, next);
 336 |     |     }
 337 |     |

 339 |     |     function _accountPoolBalanceDelta(PoolKey memory key, BalanceDelta delta, address target) internal {
 340 |     |         _accountDelta(key.currency0, delta.amount0(), target);
 341 |     |         _accountDelta(key.currency1, delta.amount1(), target);
 342 |     |     }

 346 |     |         return _pools[id];
 347 |     |     }

  1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
  2 |     | pragma solidity ^0.8.19;
  3 |     | 
  4 |     | import {Currency} from "./types/Currency.sol";
  5 |     | import {IProtocolFeeController} from "./interfaces/IProtocolFeeController.sol";
  6 |     | import {IProtocolFees} from "./interfaces/IProtocolFees.sol";
  7 |     | import {PoolKey} from "./types/PoolKey.sol";
  8 |     | import {ProtocolFeeLibrary} from "./libraries/ProtocolFeeLibrary.sol";
  9 |     | import {Owned} from "solmate/auth/Owned.sol";
 10 |     | import {PoolId, PoolIdLibrary} from "./types/PoolId.sol";
 11 |     | import {Pool} from "./libraries/Pool.sol";
 12 |     | import {CustomRevert} from "./libraries/CustomRevert.sol";
 13 |     | 
 14 |     | abstract contract ProtocolFees is IProtocolFees, Owned {
 15 |     |     using ProtocolFeeLibrary for uint24;
 16 |     |     using PoolIdLibrary for PoolKey;
 17 |     |     using Pool for Pool.State;
 18 |     |     using CustomRevert for bytes4;
 19 |     | 
 20 |     |     mapping(Currency currency => uint256) public protocolFeesAccrued;
 21 |     | 
 22 |     |     IProtocolFeeController public protocolFeeController;
 23 |     | 
 24 |     |     uint256 private immutable controllerGasLimit;
 25 |     | 
 26 |     |     constructor(uint256 _controllerGasLimit) Owned(msg.sender) {
 27 |     |         controllerGasLimit = _controllerGasLimit;
 28 |     |     }
 29 |     | 
 30 |     |     /// @inheritdoc IProtocolFees
 31 |     |     function setProtocolFeeController(IProtocolFeeController controller) external onlyOwner {
 32 |     |         protocolFeeController = controller;
 33 |     |         emit ProtocolFeeControllerUpdated(address(controller));
 34 |     |     }
 35 |     | 
 36 |     |     /// @inheritdoc IProtocolFees
 37 |     |     function setProtocolFee(PoolKey memory key, uint24 newProtocolFee) external {
 38 |     |         if (msg.sender != address(protocolFeeController)) InvalidCaller.selector.revertWith();
 39 |     |         if (!newProtocolFee.isValidProtocolFee()) InvalidProtocolFee.selector.revertWith();
 40 |     |         PoolId id = key.toId();
 41 |     |         _getPool(id).setProtocolFee(newProtocolFee);
 42 |     |         emit ProtocolFeeUpdated(id, newProtocolFee);
 43 |     |     }
 44 |     | 
 45 |     |     /// @inheritdoc IProtocolFees
 46 |     |     function collectProtocolFees(address recipient, Currency currency, uint256 amount)
 47 |     |         external
 48 |     |         returns (uint256 amountCollected)
 49 |     |     {
 50 |     |         if (msg.sender != address(protocolFeeController)) InvalidCaller.selector.revertWith();
 51 |     | 
 52 |     |         amountCollected = (amount == 0) ? protocolFeesAccrued[currency] : amount;
 53 |     |         protocolFeesAccrued[currency] -= amountCollected;
 54 |     |         currency.transfer(recipient, amountCollected);
 55 |     |     }
 56 |     | 
 57 |     |     /// @dev abstract internal function to allow the ProtocolFees contract to access pool state
 58 |     |     /// @dev this is overriden in PoolManager.sol to give access to the _pools mapping
 59 |     |     function _getPool(PoolId id) internal virtual returns (Pool.State storage);
 60 |     | 
 61 |     |     /// @notice Fetch the protocol fees for a given pool, returning false if the call fails or the returned fees are invalid.
 62 |     |     /// @dev to prevent an invalid protocol fee controller from blocking pools from being initialized
 63 |     |     ///      the success of this function is NOT checked on initialize and if the call fails, the protocol fees are set to 0.
 64 |     |     /// @dev the success of this function must be checked when called in setProtocolFee
 65 |     |     function _fetchProtocolFee(PoolKey memory key) internal returns (bool success, uint24 protocolFee) {
 66 |     |         if (address(protocolFeeController) != address(0)) {
 67 |     |             // note that EIP-150 mandates that calls requesting more than 63/64ths of remaining gas
 68 |     |             // will be allotted no more than this amount, so controllerGasLimit must be set with this
 69 |     |             // in mind.
 70 |     |             if (gasleft() < controllerGasLimit) ProtocolFeeCannotBeFetched.selector.revertWith();
 71 |     | 
 72 |     |             (bool _success, bytes memory _data) = address(protocolFeeController).call{gas: controllerGasLimit}(
 73 |     |                 abi.encodeCall(IProtocolFeeController.protocolFeeForPool, (key))
 74 |     |             );
 75 |     |             // Ensure that the return data fits within a word
 76 |     |             if (!_success || _data.length > 32) return (false, 0);
 77 |     | 
 78 |     |             uint256 returnData;
 79 |     |             assembly ("memory-safe") {
 80 |     |                 returnData := mload(add(_data, 0x20))
 81 |     |             }
 82 |     | 
 83 |     |             // Ensure return data does not overflow a uint24 and that the underlying fees are within bounds.
 84 |     |             (success, protocolFee) = (returnData == uint24(returnData)) && uint24(returnData).isValidProtocolFee()
 85 |     |                 ? (true, uint24(returnData))
 86 |     |                 : (false, 0);
 87 |     |         }
 88 |     |     }
 89 |     | 
 90 |     |     function _updateProtocolFees(Currency currency, uint256 amount) internal {
 91 |     |         unchecked {
 92 |     |             protocolFeesAccrued[currency] += amount;
 93 |     |         }
 94 |     |     }
 95 |     | }
 96 |     |

   1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
   2 |     | pragma solidity ^0.8.20;
   3 |     | 
   4 |     | /// @title BitMath
   5 |     | /// @dev This library provides functionality for computing bit properties of an unsigned integer
   6 |     | library BitMath {
   7 |     |     /// @notice Returns the index of the most significant bit of the number,
   8 |     |     ///     where the least significant bit is at index 0 and the most significant bit is at index 255
   9 |     |     /// @dev The function satisfies the property:
  10 |     |     ///     x >= 2**mostSignificantBit(x) and x < 2**(mostSignificantBit(x)+1)
  11 |     |     /// @param x the value for which to compute the most significant bit, must be greater than 0
  12 |     |     /// @return r the index of the most significant bit
  13 |     |     function mostSignificantBit(uint256 x) internal pure returns (uint8 r) {
  14 |     |         require(x > 0);
  15 |     | 
  16 |     |         unchecked {
  17 |     |             if (x >= 0x100000000000000000000000000000000) {
  18 |     |                 x >>= 128;
  19 |     |                 r += 128;
  20 |     |             }
  21 |     |             if (x >= 0x10000000000000000) {
  22 |     |                 x >>= 64;
  23 |     |                 r += 64;
  24 |     |             }
  25 |     |             if (x >= 0x100000000) {
  26 |     |                 x >>= 32;
  27 |     |                 r += 32;
  28 |     |             }
  29 |     |             if (x >= 0x10000) {
  30 |     |                 x >>= 16;
  31 |     |                 r += 16;
  32 |     |             }
  33 |     |             if (x >= 0x100) {
  34 |     |                 x >>= 8;
  35 |     |                 r += 8;
  36 |     |             }
  37 |     |             if (x >= 0x10) {
  38 |     |                 x >>= 4;
  39 |     |                 r += 4;
  40 |     |             }
  41 |     |             if (x >= 0x4) {
  42 |     |                 x >>= 2;
  43 |     |                 r += 2;
  44 |     |             }
  45 |     |             if (x >= 0x2) r += 1;
  46 |     |         }
  47 |     |     }
  48 |     | 
  49 |     |     /// @notice Returns the index of the least significant bit of the number,
  50 |     |     ///     where the least significant bit is at index 0 and the most significant bit is at index 255
  51 |     |     /// @dev The function satisfies the property:
  52 |     |     ///     (x & 2**leastSignificantBit(x)) != 0 and (x & (2**(leastSignificantBit(x)) - 1)) == 0)
  53 |     |     /// @param x the value for which to compute the least significant bit, must be greater than 0
  54 |     |     /// @return r the index of the least significant bit
  55 |     |     function leastSignificantBit(uint256 x) internal pure returns (uint8 r) {
  56 |     |         require(x > 0);
  57 |     | 
  58 |     |         unchecked {
  59 |     |             r = 255;
  60 |     |             if (x & type(uint128).max > 0) {
  61 |     |                 r -= 128;
  62 |     |             } else {
  63 |     |                 x >>= 128;
  64 |     |             }
  65 |     |             if (x & type(uint64).max > 0) {
  66 |     |                 r -= 64;
  67 |     |             } else {
  68 |     |                 x >>= 64;
  69 |     |             }
  70 |     |             if (x & type(uint32).max > 0) {
  71 |     |                 r -= 32;
  72 |     |             } else {
  73 |     |                 x >>= 32;
  74 |     |             }
  75 |     |             if (x & type(uint16).max > 0) {
  76 |     |                 r -= 16;
  77 |     |             } else {
  78 |     |                 x >>= 16;
  79 |     |             }
  80 |     |             if (x & type(uint8).max > 0) {
  81 |     |                 r -= 8;
  82 |     |             } else {
  83 |     |                 x >>= 8;
  84 |     |             }
  85 |     |             if (x & 0xf > 0) {
  86 |     |                 r -= 4;
  87 |     |             } else {
  88 |     |                 x >>= 4;
  89 |     |             }
  90 |     |             if (x & 0x3 > 0) {
  91 |     |                 r -= 2;
  92 |     |             } else {
  93 |     |                 x >>= 2;
  94 |     |             }
  95 |     |             if (x & 0x1 > 0) r -= 1;
  96 |     |         }
  97 |     |     }
  98 |     | }
  99 |     |

/home/skk/smart-contract-fuzz-v2/.tools/cache/real-contracts/phase43-20261123/liquity-V2-gov-scfuzzbench/lib/v4-core/src/libraries/FullMath.sol
   1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
   2 |     | pragma solidity ^0.8.20;
   3 |     | 
   4 |     | /// @title Contains 512-bit math functions
   5 |     | /// @notice Facilitates multiplication and division that can have overflow of an intermediate value without any loss of precision
   6 |     | /// @dev Handles "phantom overflow" i.e., allows multiplication and division where an intermediate value overflows 256 bits
   7 |     | library FullMath {
   8 |     |     /// @notice Calculates floor(a×b÷denominator) with full precision. Throws if result overflows a uint256 or denominator == 0
   9 |     |     /// @param a The multiplicand
  10 |     |     /// @param b The multiplier
  11 |     |     /// @param denominator The divisor
  12 |     |     /// @return result The 256-bit result
  13 |     |     /// @dev Credit to Remco Bloemen under MIT license https://xn--2-umb.com/21/muldiv
  14 |     |     function mulDiv(uint256 a, uint256 b, uint256 denominator) internal pure returns (uint256 result) {
  15 |     |         unchecked {
  16 |     |             // 512-bit multiply [prod1 prod0] = a * b
  17 |     |             // Compute the product mod 2**256 and mod 2**256 - 1
  18 |     |             // then use the Chinese Remainder Theorem to reconstruct
  19 |     |             // the 512 bit result. The result is stored in two 256
  20 |     |             // variables such that product = prod1 * 2**256 + prod0
  21 |     |             uint256 prod0 = a * b; // Least significant 256 bits of the product
  22 |     |             uint256 prod1; // Most significant 256 bits of the product
  23 |     |             assembly {
  24 |     |                 let mm := mulmod(a, b, not(0))
  25 |     |                 prod1 := sub(sub(mm, prod0), lt(mm, prod0))
  26 |     |             }
  27 |     | 
  28 |     |             // Make sure the result is less than 2**256.
  29 |     |             // Also prevents denominator == 0
  30 |     |             require(denominator > prod1);
  31 |     | 
  32 |     |             // Handle non-overflow cases, 256 by 256 division
  33 |     |             if (prod1 == 0) {
  34 |     |                 assembly {
  35 |     |                     result := div(prod0, denominator)
  36 |     |                 }
  37 |     |                 return result;
  38 |     |             }
  39 |     | 
  40 |     |             ///////////////////////////////////////////////
  41 |     |             // 512 by 256 division.
  42 |     |             ///////////////////////////////////////////////
  43 |     | 
  44 |     |             // Make division exact by subtracting the remainder from [prod1 prod0]
  45 |     |             // Compute remainder using mulmod
  46 |     |             uint256 remainder;
  47 |     |             assembly {
  48 |     |                 remainder := mulmod(a, b, denominator)
  49 |     |             }
  50 |     |             // Subtract 256 bit number from 512 bit number
  51 |     |             assembly {
  52 |     |                 prod1 := sub(prod1, gt(remainder, prod0))
  53 |     |                 prod0 := sub(prod0, remainder)
  54 |     |             }
  55 |     | 
  56 |     |             // Factor powers of two out of denominator
  57 |     |             // Compute largest power of two divisor of denominator.
  58 |     |             // Always >= 1.
  59 |     |             uint256 twos = (0 - denominator) & denominator;
  60 |     |             // Divide denominator by power of two
  61 |     |             assembly {
  62 |     |                 denominator := div(denominator, twos)
  63 |     |             }
  64 |     | 
  65 |     |             // Divide [prod1 prod0] by the factors of two
  66 |     |             assembly {
  67 |     |                 prod0 := div(prod0, twos)
  68 |     |             }
  69 |     |             // Shift in bits from prod1 into prod0. For this we need
  70 |     |             // to flip `twos` such that it is 2**256 / twos.
  71 |     |             // If twos is zero, then it becomes one
  72 |     |             assembly {
  73 |     |                 twos := add(div(sub(0, twos), twos), 1)
  74 |     |             }
  75 |     |             prod0 |= prod1 * twos;
  76 |     | 
  77 |     |             // Invert denominator mod 2**256
  78 |     |             // Now that denominator is an odd number, it has an inverse
  79 |     |             // modulo 2**256 such that denominator * inv = 1 mod 2**256.
  80 |     |             // Compute the inverse by starting with a seed that is correct
  81 |     |             // correct for four bits. That is, denominator * inv = 1 mod 2**4
  82 |     |             uint256 inv = (3 * denominator) ^ 2;
  83 |     |             // Now use Newton-Raphson iteration to improve the precision.
  84 |     |             // Thanks to Hensel's lifting lemma, this also works in modular
  85 |     |             // arithmetic, doubling the correct bits in each step.
  86 |     |             inv *= 2 - denominator * inv; // inverse mod 2**8
  87 |     |             inv *= 2 - denominator * inv; // inverse mod 2**16
  88 |     |             inv *= 2 - denominator * inv; // inverse mod 2**32
  89 |     |             inv *= 2 - denominator * inv; // inverse mod 2**64
  90 |     |             inv *= 2 - denominator * inv; // inverse mod 2**128
  91 |     |             inv *= 2 - denominator * inv; // inverse mod 2**256
  92 |     | 
  93 |     |             // Because the division is now exact we can divide by multiplying
  94 |     |             // with the modular inverse of denominator. This will give us the
  95 |     |             // correct result modulo 2**256. Since the preconditions guarantee
  96 |     |             // that the outcome is less than 2**256, this is the final result.
  97 |     |             // We don't need to compute the high bits of the result and prod1
  98 |     |             // is no longer required.
  99 |     |             result = prod0 * inv;
 100 |     |             return result;
 101 |     |         }
 102 |     |     }
 103 |     | 
 104 |     |     /// @notice Calculates ceil(a×b÷denominator) with full precision. Throws if result overflows a uint256 or denominator == 0
 105 |     |     /// @param a The multiplicand
 106 |     |     /// @param b The multiplier
 107 |     |     /// @param denominator The divisor
 108 |     |     /// @return result The 256-bit result
 109 |     |     function mulDivRoundingUp(uint256 a, uint256 b, uint256 denominator) internal pure returns (uint256 result) {
 110 |     |         unchecked {
 111 |     |             result = mulDiv(a, b, denominator);
 112 |     |             if (mulmod(a, b, denominator) != 0) {
 113 |     |                 require(++result > 0);
 114 |     |             }
 115 |     |         }
 116 |     |     }
 117 |     | }
 118 |     |

  14 |     | /// @notice V4 decides whether to invoke specific hooks by inspecting the lowest significant bits of the address that
  15 |     | /// the hooks contract is deployed to.
  16 |     | /// For example, a hooks contract deployed to address: 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000002400
  17 |     | /// has the lowest bits '10 0100 0000 0000' which would cause the 'before initialize' and 'after add liquidity' hooks to be used.
  18 |     | library Hooks {
  19 |     |     using LPFeeLibrary for uint24;
  20 |     |     using Hooks for IHooks;
  21 |     |     using SafeCast for int256;
  22 |     |     using BeforeSwapDeltaLibrary for BeforeSwapDelta;
  23 |     |     using ParseBytes for bytes;
  24 |     |     using CustomRevert for bytes4;
  25 |     | 
  26 |     |     uint160 internal constant ALL_HOOK_MASK = uint160((1 << 14) - 1);
  27 |     | 
  28 |     |     uint160 internal constant BEFORE_INITIALIZE_FLAG = 1 << 13;
  29 |     |     uint160 internal constant AFTER_INITIALIZE_FLAG = 1 << 12;
  30 |     | 
  31 |     |     uint160 internal constant BEFORE_ADD_LIQUIDITY_FLAG = 1 << 11;
  32 |     |     uint160 internal constant AFTER_ADD_LIQUIDITY_FLAG = 1 << 10;
  33 |     | 
  34 |     |     uint160 internal constant BEFORE_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG = 1 << 9;
  35 |     |     uint160 internal constant AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG = 1 << 8;
  36 |     | 
  37 |     |     uint160 internal constant BEFORE_SWAP_FLAG = 1 << 7;
  38 |     |     uint160 internal constant AFTER_SWAP_FLAG = 1 << 6;
  39 |     | 
  40 |     |     uint160 internal constant BEFORE_DONATE_FLAG = 1 << 5;
  41 |     |     uint160 internal constant AFTER_DONATE_FLAG = 1 << 4;
  42 |     | 
  43 |     |     uint160 internal constant BEFORE_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG = 1 << 3;
  44 |     |     uint160 internal constant AFTER_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG = 1 << 2;
  45 |     |     uint160 internal constant AFTER_ADD_LIQUIDITY_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG = 1 << 1;
  46 |     |     uint160 internal constant AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG = 1 << 0;
  47 |     | 
  48 |     |     struct Permissions {
  49 |     |         bool beforeInitialize;
  50 |     |         bool afterInitialize;
  51 |     |         bool beforeAddLiquidity;
  52 |     |         bool afterAddLiquidity;
  53 |     |         bool beforeRemoveLiquidity;

  61 |     |         bool afterAddLiquidityReturnDelta;
  62 |     |         bool afterRemoveLiquidityReturnDelta;

  65 |     |     /// @notice Thrown if the address will not lead to the specified hook calls being called
  66 |     |     /// @param hooks The address of the hooks contract
  67 |     |     error HookAddressNotValid(address hooks);
  68 |     | 
  69 |     |     /// @notice Hook did not return its selector
  70 |     |     error InvalidHookResponse();
  71 |     | 
  72 |     |     /// @notice thrown when a hook call fails
  73 |     |     error FailedHookCall();
  74 |     | 
  75 |     |     /// @notice The hook's delta changed the swap from exactIn to exactOut or vice versa
  76 |     |     error HookDeltaExceedsSwapAmount();

  78 |     |     /// @notice Utility function intended to be used in hook constructors to ensure
  79 |     |     /// the deployed hooks address causes the intended hooks to be called
  80 |     |     /// @param permissions The hooks that are intended to be called
  81 |     |     /// @dev permissions param is memory as the function will be called from constructors
  82 |     |     function validateHookPermissions(IHooks self, Permissions memory permissions) internal pure {
  83 |     |         if (
  84 |     |             permissions.beforeInitialize != self.hasPermission(BEFORE_INITIALIZE_FLAG)
  85 |     |                 || permissions.afterInitialize != self.hasPermission(AFTER_INITIALIZE_FLAG)
  86 |     |                 || permissions.beforeAddLiquidity != self.hasPermission(BEFORE_ADD_LIQUIDITY_FLAG)
  87 |     |                 || permissions.afterAddLiquidity != self.hasPermission(AFTER_ADD_LIQUIDITY_FLAG)
  88 |     |                 || permissions.beforeRemoveLiquidity != self.hasPermission(BEFORE_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG)
  89 |     |                 || permissions.afterRemoveLiquidity != self.hasPermission(AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG)
  90 |     |                 || permissions.beforeSwap != self.hasPermission(BEFORE_SWAP_FLAG)
  91 |     |                 || permissions.afterSwap != self.hasPermission(AFTER_SWAP_FLAG)
  92 |     |                 || permissions.beforeDonate != self.hasPermission(BEFORE_DONATE_FLAG)
  93 |     |                 || permissions.afterDonate != self.hasPermission(AFTER_DONATE_FLAG)
  94 |     |                 || permissions.beforeSwapReturnDelta != self.hasPermission(BEFORE_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG)
  95 |     |                 || permissions.afterSwapReturnDelta != self.hasPermission(AFTER_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG)
  96 |     |                 || permissions.afterAddLiquidityReturnDelta != self.hasPermission(AFTER_ADD_LIQUIDITY_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG)
  97 |     |                 || permissions.afterRemoveLiquidityReturnDelta
  98 |     |                     != self.hasPermission(AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG)
  99 |     |         ) {
 100 |     |             HookAddressNotValid.selector.revertWith(address(self));
 101 |     |         }
 102 |     |     }
 103 |     | 
 104 |     |     /// @notice Ensures that the hook address includes at least one hook flag or dynamic fees, or is the 0 address
 105 |     |     /// @param self The hook to verify
 106 |     |     /// @return bool True if the hook address is valid
 107 |     |     function isValidHookAddress(IHooks self, uint24 fee) internal pure returns (bool) {
 108 |     |         // The hook can only have a flag to return a hook delta on an action if it also has the corresponding action flag
 109 |     |         if (!self.hasPermission(BEFORE_SWAP_FLAG) && self.hasPermission(BEFORE_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG)) return false;
 110 |     |         if (!self.hasPermission(AFTER_SWAP_FLAG) && self.hasPermission(AFTER_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG)) return false;
 111 |     |         if (!self.hasPermission(AFTER_ADD_LIQUIDITY_FLAG) && self.hasPermission(AFTER_ADD_LIQUIDITY_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG))
 112 |     |         {
 113 |     |             return false;
 114 |     |         }
 115 |     |         if (
 116 |     |             !self.hasPermission(AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG)
 117 |     |                 && self.hasPermission(AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG)
 118 |     |         ) return false;
 119 |     | 
 120 |     |         // If there is no hook contract set, then fee cannot be dynamic
 121 |     |         // If a hook contract is set, it must have at least 1 flag set, or have a dynamic fee
 122 |     |         return address(self) == address(0)
 123 |     |             ? !fee.isDynamicFee()
 124 |     |             : (uint160(address(self)) & ALL_HOOK_MASK > 0 || fee.isDynamicFee());
 125 |     |     }
 126 |     | 
 127 |     |     /// @notice performs a hook call using the given calldata on the given hook that doesnt return a delta
 128 |     |     /// @return result The complete data returned by the hook
 129 |     |     function callHook(IHooks self, bytes memory data) internal returns (bytes memory result) {
 130 |     |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
 131 |     |             if iszero(call(gas(), self, 0, add(data, 0x20), mload(data), 0, 0)) {
 132 |     |                 if iszero(returndatasize()) {
 133 |     |                     // if the call failed without a revert reason, revert with `FailedHookCall()`
 134 |     |                     mstore(0, 0x36bc48c5)
 135 |     |                     revert(0x1c, 0x04)
 136 |     |                 }
 137 |     |                 // bubble up revert
 138 |     |                 returndatacopy(0, 0, returndatasize())
 139 |     |                 revert(0, returndatasize())
 140 |     |             }
 141 |     |             // allocate result byte array from the free memory pointer
 142 |     |             result := mload(0x40)
 143 |     |             // store new free memory pointer at the end of the array padded to 32 bytes
 144 |     |             mstore(0x40, add(result, and(add(returndatasize(), 0x3f), not(0x1f))))
 145 |     |             // store length in memory
 146 |     |             mstore(result, returndatasize())
 147 |     |             // copy return data to result
 148 |     |             returndatacopy(add(result, 0x20), 0, returndatasize())
 149 |     |         }
 150 |     | 
 151 |     |         // Check expected selector and returned selector match.
 152 |     |         if (result.parseSelector() != data.parseSelector()) InvalidHookResponse.selector.revertWith();
 153 |     |     }
 154 |     | 
 155 |     |     /// @notice performs a hook call using the given calldata on the given hook
 156 |     |     /// @return delta The delta returned by the hook
 157 |     |     function callHookWithReturnDelta(IHooks self, bytes memory data, bool parseReturn)
 158 |     |         internal
 159 |     |         returns (int256 delta)
 160 |     |     {
 161 |     |         bytes memory result = callHook(self, data);
 162 |     | 
 163 |     |         // If this hook wasnt meant to return something, default to 0 delta
 164 |     |         if (!parseReturn) return 0;
 165 |     |         return result.parseReturnDelta();
 166 |     |     }

 199 |     |     /// @notice calls beforeModifyLiquidity hook if permissioned and validates return value
 200 |     |     function beforeModifyLiquidity(
 201 |     |         IHooks self,
 202 |     |         PoolKey memory key,
 203 |     |         IPoolManager.ModifyLiquidityParams memory params,
 204 |     |         bytes calldata hookData
 205 |     |     ) internal noSelfCall(self) {
 206 |     |         if (params.liquidityDelta > 0 && self.hasPermission(BEFORE_ADD_LIQUIDITY_FLAG)) {
 207 |     |             self.callHook(abi.encodeWithSelector(IHooks.beforeAddLiquidity.selector, msg.sender, key, params, hookData));
 208 |     |         } else if (params.liquidityDelta <= 0 && self.hasPermission(BEFORE_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG)) {
 209 |     |             self.callHook(
 210 |     |                 abi.encodeWithSelector(IHooks.beforeRemoveLiquidity.selector, msg.sender, key, params, hookData)
 211 |     |             );
 212 |     |         }
 213 |     |     }
 214 |     | 
 215 |     |     /// @notice calls afterModifyLiquidity hook if permissioned and validates return value
 216 |     |     function afterModifyLiquidity(
 217 |     |         IHooks self,
 218 |     |         PoolKey memory key,
 219 |     |         IPoolManager.ModifyLiquidityParams memory params,
 220 |     |         BalanceDelta delta,
 221 |     |         bytes calldata hookData
 222 |     |     ) internal returns (BalanceDelta callerDelta, BalanceDelta hookDelta) {
 223 |     |         if (msg.sender == address(self)) return (delta, BalanceDeltaLibrary.ZERO_DELTA);
 224 |     | 
 225 |     |         callerDelta = delta;
 226 |     |         if (params.liquidityDelta > 0) {
 227 |     |             if (self.hasPermission(AFTER_ADD_LIQUIDITY_FLAG)) {
 228 |     |                 hookDelta = BalanceDelta.wrap(
 229 |     |                     self.callHookWithReturnDelta(
 230 |     |                         abi.encodeCall(IHooks.afterAddLiquidity, (msg.sender, key, params, delta, hookData)),
 231 |     |                         self.hasPermission(AFTER_ADD_LIQUIDITY_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG)
 232 |     |                     )
 233 |     |                 );
 234 |     |                 callerDelta = callerDelta - hookDelta;
 235 |     |             }
 236 |     |         } else {
 237 |     |             if (self.hasPermission(AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_FLAG)) {
 238 |     |                 hookDelta = BalanceDelta.wrap(
 239 |     |                     self.callHookWithReturnDelta(
 240 |     |                         abi.encodeCall(IHooks.afterRemoveLiquidity, (msg.sender, key, params, delta, hookData)),
 241 |     |                         self.hasPermission(AFTER_REMOVE_LIQUIDITY_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG)
 242 |     |                     )
 243 |     |                 );
 244 |     |                 callerDelta = callerDelta - hookDelta;
 245 |     |             }
 246 |     |         }
 247 |     |     }
 248 |     | 
 249 |     |     /// @notice calls beforeSwap hook if permissioned and validates return value
 250 |     |     function beforeSwap(IHooks self, PoolKey memory key, IPoolManager.SwapParams memory params, bytes calldata hookData)
 251 |     |         internal
 252 |     |         returns (int256 amountToSwap, BeforeSwapDelta hookReturn, uint24 lpFeeOverride)
 253 |     |     {
 254 |     |         amountToSwap = params.amountSpecified;
 255 |     |         if (msg.sender == address(self)) return (amountToSwap, BeforeSwapDeltaLibrary.ZERO_DELTA, lpFeeOverride);
 256 |     | 
 257 |     |         if (self.hasPermission(BEFORE_SWAP_FLAG)) {
 258 |     |             bytes memory result = callHook(self, abi.encodeCall(IHooks.beforeSwap, (msg.sender, key, params, hookData)));
 259 |     | 
 260 |     |             // dynamic fee pools that do not want to override the cache fee, return 0 otherwise they return a valid fee with the override flag
 261 |     |             if (key.fee.isDynamicFee()) lpFeeOverride = result.parseFee();
 262 |     | 
 263 |     |             // skip this logic for the case where the hook return is 0
 264 |     |             if (self.hasPermission(BEFORE_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG)) {
 265 |     |                 hookReturn = BeforeSwapDelta.wrap(result.parseReturnDelta());
 266 |     | 
 267 |     |                 // any return in unspecified is passed to the afterSwap hook for handling
 268 |     |                 int128 hookDeltaSpecified = hookReturn.getSpecifiedDelta();
 269 |     | 
 270 |     |                 // Update the swap amount according to the hook's return, and check that the swap type doesnt change (exact input/output)
 271 |     |                 if (hookDeltaSpecified != 0) {
 272 |     |                     bool exactInput = amountToSwap < 0;
 273 |     |                     amountToSwap += hookDeltaSpecified;
 274 |     |                     if (exactInput ? amountToSwap > 0 : amountToSwap < 0) {
 275 |     |                         HookDeltaExceedsSwapAmount.selector.revertWith();
 276 |     |                     }
 277 |     |                 }
 278 |     |             }
 279 |     |         }
 280 |     |     }
 281 |     | 
 282 |     |     /// @notice calls afterSwap hook if permissioned and validates return value
 283 |     |     function afterSwap(
 284 |     |         IHooks self,
 285 |     |         PoolKey memory key,
 286 |     |         IPoolManager.SwapParams memory params,
 287 |     |         BalanceDelta swapDelta,
 288 |     |         bytes calldata hookData,
 289 |     |         BeforeSwapDelta beforeSwapHookReturn
 290 |     |     ) internal returns (BalanceDelta, BalanceDelta) {
 291 |     |         if (msg.sender == address(self)) return (swapDelta, BalanceDeltaLibrary.ZERO_DELTA);
 292 |     | 
 293 |     |         int128 hookDeltaSpecified = beforeSwapHookReturn.getSpecifiedDelta();
 294 |     |         int128 hookDeltaUnspecified = beforeSwapHookReturn.getUnspecifiedDelta();
 295 |     | 
 296 |     |         if (self.hasPermission(AFTER_SWAP_FLAG)) {
 297 |     |             hookDeltaUnspecified += self.callHookWithReturnDelta(
 298 |     |                 abi.encodeCall(IHooks.afterSwap, (msg.sender, key, params, swapDelta, hookData)),
 299 |     |                 self.hasPermission(AFTER_SWAP_RETURNS_DELTA_FLAG)
 300 |     |             ).toInt128();
 301 |     |         }
 302 |     | 
 303 |     |         BalanceDelta hookDelta;
 304 |     |         if (hookDeltaUnspecified != 0 || hookDeltaSpecified != 0) {
 305 |     |             hookDelta = (params.amountSpecified < 0 == params.zeroForOne)
 306 |     |                 ? toBalanceDelta(hookDeltaSpecified, hookDeltaUnspecified)
 307 |     |                 : toBalanceDelta(hookDeltaUnspecified, hookDeltaSpecified);
 308 |     | 
 309 |     |             // the caller has to pay for (or receive) the hook's delta
 310 |     |             swapDelta = swapDelta - hookDelta;
 311 |     |         }
 312 |     |         return (swapDelta, hookDelta);
 313 |     |     }
 314 |     | 
 315 |     |     /// @notice calls beforeDonate hook if permissioned and validates return value
 316 |     |     function beforeDonate(IHooks self, PoolKey memory key, uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1, bytes calldata hookData)
 317 |     |         internal
 318 |     |         noSelfCall(self)
 319 |     |     {
 320 |     |         if (self.hasPermission(BEFORE_DONATE_FLAG)) {
 321 |     |             self.callHook(
 322 |     |                 abi.encodeWithSelector(IHooks.beforeDonate.selector, msg.sender, key, amount0, amount1, hookData)
 323 |     |             );
 324 |     |         }
 325 |     |     }
 326 |     | 
 327 |     |     /// @notice calls afterDonate hook if permissioned and validates return value
 328 |     |     function afterDonate(IHooks self, PoolKey memory key, uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1, bytes calldata hookData)
 329 |     |         internal
 330 |     |         noSelfCall(self)
 331 |     |     {

 334 |     |                 abi.encodeWithSelector(IHooks.afterDonate.selector, msg.sender, key, amount0, amount1, hookData)
 335 |     |             );
 336 |     |         }
 337 |     |     }

 339 |     |     function hasPermission(IHooks self, uint160 flag) internal pure returns (bool) {

 341 |     |     }

  4 |     | import {PoolKey} from "../types/PoolKey.sol";

  7 |     | library LPFeeLibrary {
  8 |     |     using LPFeeLibrary for uint24;
  9 |     |     using CustomRevert for bytes4;
 10 |     | 
 11 |     |     /// @notice Thrown when the static or dynamic fee on a pool exceeds 100%.
 12 |     |     error FeeTooLarge();
 13 |     | 
 14 |     |     // an lp fee of exactly 0b1000000... signals a dynamic fee pool. This isnt a valid static fee as it is > MAX_LP_FEE
 15 |     |     uint24 public constant DYNAMIC_FEE_FLAG = 0x800000;
 16 |     | 
 17 |     |     // the second bit of the fee returned by beforeSwap is used to signal if the stored LP fee should be overridden in this swap
 18 |     |     // only dynamic-fee pools can return a fee via the beforeSwap hook
 19 |     |     uint24 public constant OVERRIDE_FEE_FLAG = 0x400000;
 20 |     | 
 21 |     |     // mask to remove the override fee flag from a fee returned by the beforeSwaphook
 22 |     |     uint24 public constant REMOVE_OVERRIDE_MASK = 0xBFFFFF;
 23 |     | 
 24 |     |     // the lp fee is represented in hundredths of a bip, so the max is 100%
 25 |     |     uint24 public constant MAX_LP_FEE = 1000000;
 26 |     | 
 27 |     |     /// @notice returns true if a pool's LP fee signals that the pool has a dynamic fee
 28 |     |     function isDynamicFee(uint24 self) internal pure returns (bool) {
 29 |     |         return self == DYNAMIC_FEE_FLAG;
 30 |     |     }
 31 |     | 
 32 |     |     /// @notice returns true if an LP fee is valid, aka not above the maxmimum permitted fee
 33 |     |     function isValid(uint24 self) internal pure returns (bool) {
 34 |     |         return self <= MAX_LP_FEE;
 35 |     |     }
 36 |     | 
 37 |     |     /// @notice validates whether an LP fee is larger than the maximum, and reverts if invalid
 38 |     |     function validate(uint24 self) internal pure {
 39 |     |         if (!self.isValid()) FeeTooLarge.selector.revertWith();
 40 |     |     }
 41 |     | 
 42 |     |     /// @notice gets and validates the initial LP fee for a pool. Dynamic fee pools have an initial fee of 0.
 43 |     |     /// @dev if a dynamic fee pool wants a non-0 initial fee, it should call `updateDynamicLPFee` in the afterInitialize hook
 44 |     |     function getInitialLPFee(uint24 self) internal pure returns (uint24) {
 45 |     |         // the initial fee for a dynamic fee pool is 0
 46 |     |         if (self.isDynamicFee()) return 0;
 47 |     |         self.validate();
 48 |     |         return self;
 49 |     |     }
 50 |     | 
 51 |     |     /// @notice returns true if the fee has the override flag set (2nd highest bit of the uint24)
 52 |     |     function isOverride(uint24 self) internal pure returns (bool) {
 53 |     |         return self & OVERRIDE_FEE_FLAG != 0;
 54 |     |     }
 55 |     | 
 56 |     |     /// @notice returns a fee with the override flag removed
 57 |     |     function removeOverrideFlag(uint24 self) internal pure returns (uint24) {
 58 |     |         return self & REMOVE_OVERRIDE_MASK;
 59 |     |     }
 60 |     | 
 61 |     |     /// @notice Removes the override flag and validates the fee (reverts if the fee is too large)
 62 |     |     function removeOverrideFlagAndValidate(uint24 self) internal pure returns (uint24 fee) {
 63 |     |         fee = self.removeOverrideFlag();
 64 |     |         fee.validate();
 65 |     |     }
 66 |     | }

  4 |     | /// @title Math library for liquidity
  5 |     | library LiquidityMath {
  6 |     |     /// @notice Add a signed liquidity delta to liquidity and revert if it overflows or underflows
  7 |     |     /// @param x The liquidity before change
  8 |     |     /// @param y The delta by which liquidity should be changed
  9 |     |     /// @return z The liquidity delta
 10 |     |     function addDelta(uint128 x, int128 y) internal pure returns (uint128 z) {

 15 |     |                 mstore(0, 0x93dafdf1)
 16 |     |                 revert(0x1c, 0x04)
 17 |     |             }
 18 |     |         }
 19 |     |     }

  1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
  2 |     | pragma solidity ^0.8.20;
  3 |     | 
  4 |     | import {IHooks} from "../interfaces/IHooks.sol";
  5 |     | 
  6 |     | /// @notice This is a temporary library that allows us to use transient storage (tstore/tload)
  7 |     | /// TODO: This library can be deleted when we have the transient keyword support in solidity.
  8 |     | library Lock {
  9 |     |     // The slot holding the unlocked state, transiently. bytes32(uint256(keccak256("Unlocked")) - 1)
 10 |     |     bytes32 constant IS_UNLOCKED_SLOT = 0xc090fc4683624cfc3884e9d8de5eca132f2d0ec062aff75d43c0465d5ceeab23;
 11 |     | 
 12 |     |     function unlock() internal {
 13 |     |         assembly {
 14 |     |             // unlock
 15 |     |             tstore(IS_UNLOCKED_SLOT, true)
 16 |     |         }
 17 |     |     }
 18 |     | 
 19 |     |     function lock() internal {
 20 |     |         assembly {
 21 |     |             tstore(IS_UNLOCKED_SLOT, false)
 22 |     |         }
 23 |     |     }
 24 |     | 
 25 |     |     function isUnlocked() internal view returns (bool unlocked) {
 26 |     |         assembly {
