 123 |     |     struct ModifyLiquidityParams {
 124 |     |         // the address that owns the position
 125 |     |         address owner;
 126 |     |         // the lower and upper tick of the position
 127 |     |         int24 tickLower;
 128 |     |         int24 tickUpper;
 129 |     |         // any change in liquidity
 130 |     |         int128 liquidityDelta;
 131 |     |         // the spacing between ticks
 132 |     |         int24 tickSpacing;
 133 |     |         // used to distinguish positions of the same owner, at the same tick range
 134 |     |         bytes32 salt;
 135 |     |     }
 136 |     | 
 137 |     |     struct ModifyLiquidityState {
 138 |     |         bool flippedLower;
 139 |     |         uint128 liquidityGrossAfterLower;
 140 |     |         bool flippedUpper;
 141 |     |         uint128 liquidityGrossAfterUpper;
 142 |     |     }
 143 |     | 
 144 |     |     /// @notice Effect changes to a position in a pool
 145 |     |     /// @dev PoolManager checks that the pool is initialized before calling
 146 |     |     /// @param params the position details and the change to the position's liquidity to effect
 147 |     |     /// @return delta the deltas of the token balances of the pool, from the liquidity change
 148 |     |     /// @return feeDelta the fees generated by the liquidity range
 149 |     |     function modifyLiquidity(State storage self, ModifyLiquidityParams memory params)
 150 |     |         internal
 151 |     |         returns (BalanceDelta delta, BalanceDelta feeDelta)
 152 |     |     {
 153 |     |         int128 liquidityDelta = params.liquidityDelta;
 154 |     |         int24 tickLower = params.tickLower;
 155 |     |         int24 tickUpper = params.tickUpper;
 156 |     |         checkTicks(tickLower, tickUpper);
 157 |     | 
 158 |     |         {
 159 |     |             ModifyLiquidityState memory state;
 160 |     | 
 161 |     |             // if we need to update the ticks, do it
 162 |     |             if (liquidityDelta != 0) {
 163 |     |                 (state.flippedLower, state.liquidityGrossAfterLower) =
 164 |     |                     updateTick(self, tickLower, liquidityDelta, false);
 165 |     |                 (state.flippedUpper, state.liquidityGrossAfterUpper) = updateTick(self, tickUpper, liquidityDelta, true);
 166 |     | 
 167 |     |                 // `>` and `>=` are logically equivalent here but `>=` is cheaper
 168 |     |                 if (liquidityDelta >= 0) {
 169 |     |                     uint128 maxLiquidityPerTick = tickSpacingToMaxLiquidityPerTick(params.tickSpacing);
 170 |     |                     if (state.liquidityGrossAfterLower > maxLiquidityPerTick) {
 171 |     |                         TickLiquidityOverflow.selector.revertWith(tickLower);
 172 |     |                     }
 173 |     |                     if (state.liquidityGrossAfterUpper > maxLiquidityPerTick) {
 174 |     |                         TickLiquidityOverflow.selector.revertWith(tickUpper);
 175 |     |                     }
 176 |     |                 }
 177 |     | 
 178 |     |                 if (state.flippedLower) {
 179 |     |                     self.tickBitmap.flipTick(tickLower, params.tickSpacing);
 180 |     |                 }
 181 |     |                 if (state.flippedUpper) {
 182 |     |                     self.tickBitmap.flipTick(tickUpper, params.tickSpacing);
 183 |     |                 }
 184 |     |             }
 185 |     | 
 186 |     |             {
 187 |     |                 (uint256 feeGrowthInside0X128, uint256 feeGrowthInside1X128) =
 188 |     |                     getFeeGrowthInside(self, tickLower, tickUpper);
 189 |     | 
 190 |     |                 Position.Info storage position = self.positions.get(params.owner, tickLower, tickUpper, params.salt);
 191 |     |                 (uint256 feesOwed0, uint256 feesOwed1) =
 192 |     |                     position.update(liquidityDelta, feeGrowthInside0X128, feeGrowthInside1X128);
 193 |     | 
 194 |     |                 // Fees earned from LPing are added to the user's currency delta.
 195 |     |                 feeDelta = toBalanceDelta(feesOwed0.toInt128(), feesOwed1.toInt128());
 196 |     |             }
 197 |     | 
 198 |     |             // clear any tick data that is no longer needed
 199 |     |             if (liquidityDelta < 0) {
 200 |     |                 if (state.flippedLower) {
 201 |     |                     clearTick(self, tickLower);
 202 |     |                 }
 203 |     |                 if (state.flippedUpper) {
 204 |     |                     clearTick(self, tickUpper);
 205 |     |                 }
 206 |     |             }
 207 |     |         }
 208 |     | 
 209 |     |         if (liquidityDelta != 0) {
 210 |     |             Slot0 _slot0 = self.slot0;
 211 |     |             (int24 tick, uint160 sqrtPriceX96) = (_slot0.tick(), _slot0.sqrtPriceX96());
 212 |     |             if (tick < tickLower) {
 213 |     |                 // current tick is below the passed range; liquidity can only become in range by crossing from left to
 214 |     |                 // right, when we'll need _more_ currency0 (it's becoming more valuable) so user must provide it
 215 |     |                 delta = toBalanceDelta(
 216 |     |                     SqrtPriceMath.getAmount0Delta(
 217 |     |                         TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(tickLower), TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(tickUpper), liquidityDelta
 218 |     |                     ).toInt128(),
 219 |     |                     0
 220 |     |                 );
 221 |     |             } else if (tick < tickUpper) {
 222 |     |                 delta = toBalanceDelta(
 223 |     |                     SqrtPriceMath.getAmount0Delta(sqrtPriceX96, TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(tickUpper), liquidityDelta)
 224 |     |                         .toInt128(),
 225 |     |                     SqrtPriceMath.getAmount1Delta(TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(tickLower), sqrtPriceX96, liquidityDelta)
 226 |     |                         .toInt128()
 227 |     |                 );
 228 |     | 
 229 |     |                 self.liquidity = LiquidityMath.addDelta(self.liquidity, liquidityDelta);
 230 |     |             } else {
 231 |     |                 // current tick is above the passed range; liquidity can only become in range by crossing from right to
 232 |     |                 // left, when we'll need _more_ currency1 (it's becoming more valuable) so user must provide it
 233 |     |                 delta = toBalanceDelta(
 234 |     |                     0,
 235 |     |                     SqrtPriceMath.getAmount1Delta(
 236 |     |                         TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(tickLower), TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(tickUpper), liquidityDelta
 237 |     |                     ).toInt128()
 238 |     |                 );
 239 |     |             }
 240 |     |         }
 241 |     |     }
 242 |     | 
 243 |     |     // the top level state of the swap, the results of which are recorded in storage at the end
 244 |     |     struct SwapState {
 245 |     |         // the amount remaining to be swapped in/out of the input/output asset
 246 |     |         int256 amountSpecifiedRemaining;
 247 |     |         // the amount already swapped out/in of the output/input asset
 248 |     |         int256 amountCalculated;
 249 |     |         // current sqrt(price)
 250 |     |         uint160 sqrtPriceX96;
 251 |     |         // the tick associated with the current price
 252 |     |         int24 tick;
 253 |     |         // the global fee growth of the input token
 254 |     |         uint256 feeGrowthGlobalX128;
 255 |     |         // the current liquidity in range
 256 |     |         uint128 liquidity;
 257 |     |     }
 258 |     | 
 259 |     |     struct StepComputations {
 260 |     |         // the price at the beginning of the step
 261 |     |         uint160 sqrtPriceStartX96;
 262 |     |         // the next tick to swap to from the current tick in the swap direction
 263 |     |         int24 tickNext;
 264 |     |         // whether tickNext is initialized or not
 265 |     |         bool initialized;
 266 |     |         // sqrt(price) for the next tick (1/0)
 267 |     |         uint160 sqrtPriceNextX96;
 268 |     |         // how much is being swapped in in this step
 269 |     |         uint256 amountIn;
 270 |     |         // how much is being swapped out
 271 |     |         uint256 amountOut;
 272 |     |         // how much fee is being paid in
 273 |     |         uint256 feeAmount;
 274 |     |     }
 275 |     | 
 276 |     |     struct SwapParams {
 277 |     |         int24 tickSpacing;
 278 |     |         bool zeroForOne;
 279 |     |         int256 amountSpecified;
 280 |     |         uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96;
 281 |     |         uint24 lpFeeOverride;
 282 |     |     }
 283 |     | 
 284 |     |     /// @notice Executes a swap against the state, and returns the amount deltas of the pool
 285 |     |     /// @dev PoolManager checks that the pool is initialized before calling
 286 |     |     function swap(State storage self, SwapParams memory params)
 287 |     |         internal
 288 |     |         returns (BalanceDelta result, uint256 feeForProtocol, uint24 swapFee, SwapState memory state)
 289 |     |     {
 290 |     |         Slot0 slot0Start = self.slot0;
 291 |     |         bool zeroForOne = params.zeroForOne;
 292 |     | 
 293 |     |         uint128 liquidityStart = self.liquidity;
 294 |     |         uint256 protocolFee =
 295 |     |             zeroForOne ? slot0Start.protocolFee().getZeroForOneFee() : slot0Start.protocolFee().getOneForZeroFee();
 296 |     | 
 297 |     |         state.amountSpecifiedRemaining = params.amountSpecified;
 298 |     |         state.amountCalculated = 0;
 299 |     |         state.sqrtPriceX96 = slot0Start.sqrtPriceX96();
 300 |     |         state.tick = slot0Start.tick();
 301 |     |         state.feeGrowthGlobalX128 = zeroForOne ? self.feeGrowthGlobal0X128 : self.feeGrowthGlobal1X128;
 302 |     |         state.liquidity = liquidityStart;
 303 |     | 
 304 |     |         // if the beforeSwap hook returned a valid fee override, use that as the LP fee, otherwise load from storage
 305 |     |         {
 306 |     |             uint24 lpFee = params.lpFeeOverride.isOverride()
 307 |     |                 ? params.lpFeeOverride.removeOverrideFlagAndValidate()
 308 |     |                 : slot0Start.lpFee();
 309 |     | 
 310 |     |             swapFee = protocolFee == 0 ? lpFee : uint24(protocolFee).calculateSwapFee(lpFee);
 311 |     |         }
 312 |     | 
 313 |     |         bool exactInput = params.amountSpecified < 0;
 314 |     | 
 315 |     |         if (!exactInput && (swapFee == LPFeeLibrary.MAX_LP_FEE)) {
 316 |     |             InvalidFeeForExactOut.selector.revertWith();
 317 |     |         }
 318 |     | 
 319 |     |         if (params.amountSpecified == 0) return (BalanceDeltaLibrary.ZERO_DELTA, 0, swapFee, state);
 320 |     | 
 321 |     |         if (zeroForOne) {
 322 |     |             if (params.sqrtPriceLimitX96 >= slot0Start.sqrtPriceX96()) {
 323 |     |                 PriceLimitAlreadyExceeded.selector.revertWith(slot0Start.sqrtPriceX96(), params.sqrtPriceLimitX96);
 324 |     |             }
 325 |     |             if (params.sqrtPriceLimitX96 <= TickMath.MIN_SQRT_PRICE) {
 326 |     |                 PriceLimitOutOfBounds.selector.revertWith(params.sqrtPriceLimitX96);
 327 |     |             }
 328 |     |         } else {
 329 |     |             if (params.sqrtPriceLimitX96 <= slot0Start.sqrtPriceX96()) {
 330 |     |                 PriceLimitAlreadyExceeded.selector.revertWith(slot0Start.sqrtPriceX96(), params.sqrtPriceLimitX96);
 331 |     |             }
 332 |     |             if (params.sqrtPriceLimitX96 >= TickMath.MAX_SQRT_PRICE) {
 333 |     |                 PriceLimitOutOfBounds.selector.revertWith(params.sqrtPriceLimitX96);
 334 |     |             }
 335 |     |         }
 336 |     | 
 337 |     |         StepComputations memory step;
 338 |     | 
 339 |     |         // continue swapping as long as we haven't used the entire input/output and haven't reached the price limit
 340 |     |         while (!(state.amountSpecifiedRemaining == 0 || state.sqrtPriceX96 == params.sqrtPriceLimitX96)) {
 341 |     |             step.sqrtPriceStartX96 = state.sqrtPriceX96;
 342 |     | 
 343 |     |             (step.tickNext, step.initialized) =
 344 |     |                 self.tickBitmap.nextInitializedTickWithinOneWord(state.tick, params.tickSpacing, zeroForOne);
 345 |     | 
 346 |     |             // ensure that we do not overshoot the min/max tick, as the tick bitmap is not aware of these bounds
 347 |     |             if (step.tickNext <= TickMath.MIN_TICK) {
 348 |     |                 step.tickNext = TickMath.MIN_TICK;
 349 |     |             }
 350 |     |             if (step.tickNext >= TickMath.MAX_TICK) {
 351 |     |                 step.tickNext = TickMath.MAX_TICK;
 352 |     |             }
 353 |     | 
 354 |     |             // get the price for the next tick
 355 |     |             step.sqrtPriceNextX96 = TickMath.getSqrtPriceAtTick(step.tickNext);
 356 |     | 
 357 |     |             // compute values to swap to the target tick, price limit, or point where input/output amount is exhausted
 358 |     |             (state.sqrtPriceX96, step.amountIn, step.amountOut, step.feeAmount) = SwapMath.computeSwapStep(
 359 |     |                 state.sqrtPriceX96,
 360 |     |                 SwapMath.getSqrtPriceTarget(zeroForOne, step.sqrtPriceNextX96, params.sqrtPriceLimitX96),
 361 |     |                 state.liquidity,
 362 |     |                 state.amountSpecifiedRemaining,
 363 |     |                 swapFee
 364 |     |             );
 365 |     | 
 366 |     |             if (!exactInput) {
 367 |     |                 unchecked {
 368 |     |                     state.amountSpecifiedRemaining -= step.amountOut.toInt256();
 369 |     |                 }
 370 |     |                 state.amountCalculated = state.amountCalculated - (step.amountIn + step.feeAmount).toInt256();
 371 |     |             } else {
 372 |     |                 // safe because we test that amountSpecified > amountIn + feeAmount in SwapMath
 373 |     |                 unchecked {
 374 |     |                     state.amountSpecifiedRemaining += (step.amountIn + step.feeAmount).toInt256();
 375 |     |                 }
 376 |     |                 state.amountCalculated = state.amountCalculated + step.amountOut.toInt256();
 377 |     |             }
 378 |     | 
 379 |     |             // if the protocol fee is on, calculate how much is owed, decrement feeAmount, and increment protocolFee
 380 |     |             if (protocolFee > 0) {
 381 |     |                 unchecked {
 382 |     |                     // step.amountIn does not include the swap fee, as it's already been taken from it,
 383 |     |                     // so add it back to get the total amountIn and use that to calculate the amount of fees owed to the protocol
 384 |     |                     uint256 delta = (step.amountIn + step.feeAmount) * protocolFee / ProtocolFeeLibrary.PIPS_DENOMINATOR;
 385 |     |                     // subtract it from the total fee and add it to the protocol fee
 386 |     |                     step.feeAmount -= delta;
 387 |     |                     feeForProtocol += delta;
 388 |     |                 }
 389 |     |             }
 390 |     | 
 391 |     |             // update global fee tracker
 392 |     |             if (state.liquidity > 0) {
 393 |     |                 unchecked {
 394 |     |                     state.feeGrowthGlobalX128 += FullMath.mulDiv(step.feeAmount, FixedPoint128.Q128, state.liquidity);
 395 |     |                 }
 396 |     |             }
 397 |     | 
 398 |     |             // shift tick if we reached the next price
 399 |     |             if (state.sqrtPriceX96 == step.sqrtPriceNextX96) {
 400 |     |                 // if the tick is initialized, run the tick transition
 401 |     |                 if (step.initialized) {
 402 |     |                     (uint256 feeGrowthGlobal0X128, uint256 feeGrowthGlobal1X128) = zeroForOne
 403 |     |                         ? (state.feeGrowthGlobalX128, self.feeGrowthGlobal1X128)
 404 |     |                         : (self.feeGrowthGlobal0X128, state.feeGrowthGlobalX128);
 405 |     |                     int128 liquidityNet =
 406 |     |                         Pool.crossTick(self, step.tickNext, feeGrowthGlobal0X128, feeGrowthGlobal1X128);
 407 |     |                     // if we're moving leftward, we interpret liquidityNet as the opposite sign
 408 |     |                     // safe because liquidityNet cannot be type(int128).min
 409 |     |                     unchecked {
 410 |     |                         if (zeroForOne) liquidityNet = -liquidityNet;
 411 |     |                     }
 412 |     | 
 413 |     |                     state.liquidity = LiquidityMath.addDelta(state.liquidity, liquidityNet);
 414 |     |                 }
 415 |     | 
 416 |     |                 // Equivalent to `state.tick = zeroForOne ? step.tickNext - 1 : step.tickNext;`
 417 |     |                 unchecked {
 418 |     |                     // cannot cast a bool to an int24 in Solidity
 419 |     |                     int24 _zeroForOne;
 420 |     |                     assembly {
 421 |     |                         _zeroForOne := zeroForOne
 422 |     |                     }
 423 |     |                     state.tick = step.tickNext - _zeroForOne;
 424 |     |                 }
 425 |     |             } else if (state.sqrtPriceX96 != step.sqrtPriceStartX96) {
 426 |     |                 // recompute unless we're on a lower tick boundary (i.e. already transitioned ticks), and haven't moved
 427 |     |                 state.tick = TickMath.getTickAtSqrtPrice(state.sqrtPriceX96);
 428 |     |             }
 429 |     |         }
 430 |     | 
 431 |     |         self.slot0 = slot0Start.setTick(state.tick).setSqrtPriceX96(state.sqrtPriceX96);
 432 |     | 
 433 |     |         // update liquidity if it changed
 434 |     |         if (liquidityStart != state.liquidity) self.liquidity = state.liquidity;
 435 |     | 
 436 |     |         // update fee growth global
 437 |     |         if (!zeroForOne) {
 438 |     |             self.feeGrowthGlobal1X128 = state.feeGrowthGlobalX128;
 439 |     |         } else {
 440 |     |             self.feeGrowthGlobal0X128 = state.feeGrowthGlobalX128;
 441 |     |         }
 442 |     | 
 443 |     |         unchecked {
 444 |     |             if (zeroForOne != exactInput) {
 445 |     |                 result = toBalanceDelta(
 446 |     |                     state.amountCalculated.toInt128(),
 447 |     |                     (params.amountSpecified - state.amountSpecifiedRemaining).toInt128()
 448 |     |                 );
 449 |     |             } else {
 450 |     |                 result = toBalanceDelta(
 451 |     |                     (params.amountSpecified - state.amountSpecifiedRemaining).toInt128(),
 452 |     |                     state.amountCalculated.toInt128()
 453 |     |                 );
 454 |     |             }
 455 |     |         }
 456 |     |     }
 457 |     | 
 458 |     |     /// @notice Donates the given amount of currency0 and currency1 to the pool
 459 |     |     function donate(State storage state, uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) internal returns (BalanceDelta delta) {
 460 |     |         uint128 liquidity = state.liquidity;
 461 |     |         if (liquidity == 0) NoLiquidityToReceiveFees.selector.revertWith();
 462 |     |         unchecked {
 463 |     |             // negation safe as amount0 and amount1 are always positive
 464 |     |             delta = toBalanceDelta(-(amount0.toInt128()), -(amount1.toInt128()));
 465 |     |             if (amount0 > 0) {
 466 |     |                 state.feeGrowthGlobal0X128 += FullMath.mulDiv(amount0, FixedPoint128.Q128, liquidity);
 467 |     |             }
 468 |     |             if (amount1 > 0) {
 469 |     |                 state.feeGrowthGlobal1X128 += FullMath.mulDiv(amount1, FixedPoint128.Q128, liquidity);
 470 |     |             }
 471 |     |         }
 472 |     |     }
 473 |     | 
 474 |     |     /// @notice Retrieves fee growth data
 475 |     |     /// @param self The Pool state struct
 476 |     |     /// @param tickLower The lower tick boundary of the position
 477 |     |     /// @param tickUpper The upper tick boundary of the position
 478 |     |     /// @return feeGrowthInside0X128 The all-time fee growth in token0, per unit of liquidity, inside the position's tick boundaries
 479 |     |     /// @return feeGrowthInside1X128 The all-time fee growth in token1, per unit of liquidity, inside the position's tick boundaries
 480 |     |     function getFeeGrowthInside(State storage self, int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper)
 481 |     |         internal
 482 |     |         view
 483 |     |         returns (uint256 feeGrowthInside0X128, uint256 feeGrowthInside1X128)
 484 |     |     {
 485 |     |         TickInfo storage lower = self.ticks[tickLower];
 486 |     |         TickInfo storage upper = self.ticks[tickUpper];
 487 |     |         int24 tickCurrent = self.slot0.tick();
 488 |     | 
 489 |     |         unchecked {
 490 |     |             if (tickCurrent < tickLower) {
 491 |     |                 feeGrowthInside0X128 = lower.feeGrowthOutside0X128 - upper.feeGrowthOutside0X128;
 492 |     |                 feeGrowthInside1X128 = lower.feeGrowthOutside1X128 - upper.feeGrowthOutside1X128;
 493 |     |             } else if (tickCurrent >= tickUpper) {
 494 |     |                 feeGrowthInside0X128 = upper.feeGrowthOutside0X128 - lower.feeGrowthOutside0X128;
 495 |     |                 feeGrowthInside1X128 = upper.feeGrowthOutside1X128 - lower.feeGrowthOutside1X128;
 496 |     |             } else {
 497 |     |                 feeGrowthInside0X128 =
 498 |     |                     self.feeGrowthGlobal0X128 - lower.feeGrowthOutside0X128 - upper.feeGrowthOutside0X128;
 499 |     |                 feeGrowthInside1X128 =
 500 |     |                     self.feeGrowthGlobal1X128 - lower.feeGrowthOutside1X128 - upper.feeGrowthOutside1X128;
 501 |     |             }
 502 |     |         }
 503 |     |     }
 504 |     | 
 505 |     |     /// @notice Updates a tick and returns true if the tick was flipped from initialized to uninitialized, or vice versa
 506 |     |     /// @param self The mapping containing all tick information for initialized ticks
 507 |     |     /// @param tick The tick that will be updated
 508 |     |     /// @param liquidityDelta A new amount of liquidity to be added (subtracted) when tick is crossed from left to right (right to left)
 509 |     |     /// @param upper true for updating a position's upper tick, or false for updating a position's lower tick
 510 |     |     /// @return flipped Whether the tick was flipped from initialized to uninitialized, or vice versa
 511 |     |     /// @return liquidityGrossAfter The total amount of  liquidity for all positions that references the tick after the update
 512 |     |     function updateTick(State storage self, int24 tick, int128 liquidityDelta, bool upper)
 513 |     |         internal
 514 |     |         returns (bool flipped, uint128 liquidityGrossAfter)
 515 |     |     {
 516 |     |         TickInfo storage info = self.ticks[tick];
 517 |     | 
 518 |     |         uint128 liquidityGrossBefore;
 519 |     |         int128 liquidityNetBefore;
 520 |     |         assembly {
 521 |     |             // load first slot of info which contains liquidityGross and liquidityNet packed
 522 |     |             // where the top 128 bits are liquidityNet and the bottom 128 bits are liquidityGross
 523 |     |             let liquidity := sload(info.slot)
 524 |     |             // slice off top 128 bits of liquidity (liquidityNet) to get just liquidityGross
 525 |     |             liquidityGrossBefore := shr(128, shl(128, liquidity))
 526 |     |             // signed shift right 128 bits to get just liquidityNet
 527 |     |             liquidityNetBefore := sar(128, liquidity)
 528 |     |         }
 529 |     | 
 530 |     |         liquidityGrossAfter = LiquidityMath.addDelta(liquidityGrossBefore, liquidityDelta);
 531 |     | 
 532 |     |         flipped = (liquidityGrossAfter == 0) != (liquidityGrossBefore == 0);
 533 |     | 
 534 |     |         if (liquidityGrossBefore == 0) {
 535 |     |             // by convention, we assume that all growth before a tick was initialized happened _below_ the tick
 536 |     |             if (tick <= self.slot0.tick()) {
 537 |     |                 info.feeGrowthOutside0X128 = self.feeGrowthGlobal0X128;
 538 |     |                 info.feeGrowthOutside1X128 = self.feeGrowthGlobal1X128;
 539 |     |             }
 540 |     |         }
 541 |     | 
 542 |     |         // when the lower (upper) tick is crossed left to right (right to left), liquidity must be added (removed)
 543 |     |         int128 liquidityNet = upper ? liquidityNetBefore - liquidityDelta : liquidityNetBefore + liquidityDelta;
 544 |     |         assembly {
 545 |     |             // liquidityGrossAfter and liquidityNet are packed in the first slot of `info`
 546 |     |             // So we can store them with a single sstore by packing them ourselves first
 547 |     |             sstore(
 548 |     |                 info.slot,
 549 |     |                 // bitwise OR to pack liquidityGrossAfter and liquidityNet
 550 |     |                 or(
 551 |     |                     // liquidityGross is in the low bits, upper bits are already 0
 552 |     |                     liquidityGrossAfter,
 553 |     |                     // shift liquidityNet to take the upper bits and lower bits get filled with 0
 554 |     |                     shl(128, liquidityNet)
 555 |     |                 )
 556 |     |             )
 557 |     |         }
 558 |     |     }
 559 |     | 
 560 |     |     /// @notice Derives max liquidity per tick from given tick spacing
 561 |     |     /// @dev Executed within the pool constructor
 562 |     |     /// @param tickSpacing The amount of required tick separation, realized in multiples of `tickSpacing`
 563 |     |     ///     e.g., a tickSpacing of 3 requires ticks to be initialized every 3rd tick i.e., ..., -6, -3, 0, 3, 6, ...
 564 |     |     /// @return result The max liquidity per tick
 565 |     |     function tickSpacingToMaxLiquidityPerTick(int24 tickSpacing) internal pure returns (uint128 result) {
 566 |     |         // Equivalent to:
 567 |     |         // int24 minTick = (TickMath.MIN_TICK / tickSpacing) * tickSpacing;
 568 |     |         // int24 maxTick = (TickMath.MAX_TICK / tickSpacing) * tickSpacing;
 569 |     |         // uint24 numTicks = uint24((maxTick - minTick) / tickSpacing) + 1;
 570 |     |         // return type(uint128).max / numTicks;
 571 |     |         int24 MAX_TICK = TickMath.MAX_TICK;
 572 |     |         int24 MIN_TICK = TickMath.MIN_TICK;
 573 |     |         // tick spacing will never be 0 since TickMath.MIN_TICK_SPACING is 1
 574 |     |         assembly {
 575 |     |             let minTick := mul(sdiv(MIN_TICK, tickSpacing), tickSpacing)
 576 |     |             let maxTick := mul(sdiv(MAX_TICK, tickSpacing), tickSpacing)
 577 |     |             let numTicks := add(sdiv(sub(maxTick, minTick), tickSpacing), 1)
 578 |     |             result := div(sub(shl(128, 1), 1), numTicks)
 579 |     |         }
 580 |     |     }
 581 |     | 
 582 |     |     /// @notice Reverts if the given pool has not been initialized
 583 |     |     function checkPoolInitialized(State storage self) internal view {
 584 |     |         if (self.slot0.sqrtPriceX96() == 0) PoolNotInitialized.selector.revertWith();
 585 |     |     }
 586 |     | 
 587 |     |     /// @notice Clears tick data
 588 |     |     /// @param self The mapping containing all initialized tick information for initialized ticks
 589 |     |     /// @param tick The tick that will be cleared
 590 |     |     function clearTick(State storage self, int24 tick) internal {
 591 |     |         delete self.ticks[tick];
 592 |     |     }
 593 |     | 
 594 |     |     /// @notice Transitions to next tick as needed by price movement
 595 |     |     /// @param self The Pool state struct
 596 |     |     /// @param tick The destination tick of the transition
 597 |     |     /// @param feeGrowthGlobal0X128 The all-time global fee growth, per unit of liquidity, in token0
 598 |     |     /// @param feeGrowthGlobal1X128 The all-time global fee growth, per unit of liquidity, in token1
 599 |     |     /// @return liquidityNet The amount of liquidity added (subtracted) when tick is crossed from left to right (right to left)
 600 |     |     function crossTick(State storage self, int24 tick, uint256 feeGrowthGlobal0X128, uint256 feeGrowthGlobal1X128)
 601 |     |         internal
 602 |     |         returns (int128 liquidityNet)
 603 |     |     {
 604 |     |         unchecked {
 605 |     |             TickInfo storage info = self.ticks[tick];
 606 |     |             info.feeGrowthOutside0X128 = feeGrowthGlobal0X128 - info.feeGrowthOutside0X128;
 607 |     |             info.feeGrowthOutside1X128 = feeGrowthGlobal1X128 - info.feeGrowthOutside1X128;
 608 |     |             liquidityNet = info.liquidityNet;
 609 |     |         }
 610 |     |     }
 611 |     | }

  9 |     | /// @title Position
 10 |     | /// @notice Positions represent an owner address' liquidity between a lower and upper tick boundary
 11 |     | /// @dev Positions store additional state for tracking fees owed to the position
 12 |     | library Position {

 14 |     | 
 15 |     |     /// @notice Cannot update a position with no liquidity
 16 |     |     error CannotUpdateEmptyPosition();
 17 |     | 
 18 |     |     // info stored for each user's position
 19 |     |     struct Info {
 20 |     |         // the amount of liquidity owned by this position
 21 |     |         uint128 liquidity;
 22 |     |         // fee growth per unit of liquidity as of the last update to liquidity or fees owed
 23 |     |         uint256 feeGrowthInside0LastX128;
 24 |     |         uint256 feeGrowthInside1LastX128;
 25 |     |     }
 26 |     | 
 27 |     |     /// @notice Returns the Info struct of a position, given an owner and position boundaries
 28 |     |     /// @param self The mapping containing all user positions
 29 |     |     /// @param owner The address of the position owner
 30 |     |     /// @param tickLower The lower tick boundary of the position
 31 |     |     /// @param tickUpper The upper tick boundary of the position
 32 |     |     /// @param salt A unique value to differentiate between multiple positions in the same range
 33 |     |     /// @return position The position info struct of the given owners' position
 34 |     |     function get(mapping(bytes32 => Info) storage self, address owner, int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper, bytes32 salt)
 35 |     |         internal
 36 |     |         view
 37 |     |         returns (Info storage position)
 38 |     |     {
 39 |     |         // positionKey = keccak256(abi.encodePacked(owner, tickLower, tickUpper, salt))
 40 |     |         bytes32 positionKey;
 41 |     | 
 42 |     |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
 43 |     |             mstore(0x26, salt) // [0x26, 0x46)
 44 |     |             mstore(0x06, tickUpper) // [0x23, 0x26)
 45 |     |             mstore(0x03, tickLower) // [0x20, 0x23)
 46 |     |             mstore(0, owner) // [0x0c, 0x20)
 47 |     |             positionKey := keccak256(0x0c, 0x3a) // len is 58 bytes
 48 |     |             mstore(0x26, 0) // rewrite 0x26 to 0
 49 |     |         }
 50 |     |         position = self[positionKey];
 51 |     |     }
 52 |     | 
 53 |     |     /// @notice Credits accumulated fees to a user's position
 54 |     |     /// @param self The individual position to update
 55 |     |     /// @param liquidityDelta The change in pool liquidity as a result of the position update
 56 |     |     /// @param feeGrowthInside0X128 The all-time fee growth in currency0, per unit of liquidity, inside the position's tick boundaries
 57 |     |     /// @param feeGrowthInside1X128 The all-time fee growth in currency1, per unit of liquidity, inside the position's tick boundaries
 58 |     |     /// @return feesOwed0 The amount of currency0 owed to the position owner
 59 |     |     /// @return feesOwed1 The amount of currency1 owed to the position owner
 60 |     |     function update(
 61 |     |         Info storage self,
 62 |     |         int128 liquidityDelta,
 63 |     |         uint256 feeGrowthInside0X128,
 64 |     |         uint256 feeGrowthInside1X128
 65 |     |     ) internal returns (uint256 feesOwed0, uint256 feesOwed1) {
 66 |     |         uint128 liquidity = self.liquidity;
 67 |     | 
 68 |     |         if (liquidityDelta == 0) {
 69 |     |             // disallow pokes for 0 liquidity positions
 70 |     |             if (liquidity == 0) CannotUpdateEmptyPosition.selector.revertWith();
 71 |     |         } else {
 72 |     |             self.liquidity = LiquidityMath.addDelta(liquidity, liquidityDelta);
 73 |     |         }
 74 |     | 
 75 |     |         // calculate accumulated fees. overflow in the subtraction of fee growth is expected
 76 |     |         unchecked {
 77 |     |             feesOwed0 =
 78 |     |                 FullMath.mulDiv(feeGrowthInside0X128 - self.feeGrowthInside0LastX128, liquidity, FixedPoint128.Q128);
 79 |     |             feesOwed1 =

 81 |     |         }

 85 |     |         self.feeGrowthInside1LastX128 = feeGrowthInside1X128;
 86 |     |     }

  1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
  2 |     | pragma solidity ^0.8.20;
  3 |     | 
  4 |     | library ProtocolFeeLibrary {
  5 |     |     // Max protocol fee is 0.1% (1000 pips)
  6 |     |     uint16 public constant MAX_PROTOCOL_FEE = 1000;
  7 |     | 
  8 |     |     // Thresholds used for optimized bounds checks on protocol fees
  9 |     |     uint24 internal constant FEE_0_THRESHOLD = 1001;
 10 |     |     uint24 internal constant FEE_1_THRESHOLD = 1001 << 12;
 11 |     | 
 12 |     |     // the protocol fee is represented in hundredths of a bip
 13 |     |     uint256 internal constant PIPS_DENOMINATOR = 1_000_000;
 14 |     | 
 15 |     |     function getZeroForOneFee(uint24 self) internal pure returns (uint16) {
 16 |     |         return uint16(self & 0xfff);
 17 |     |     }
 18 |     | 
 19 |     |     function getOneForZeroFee(uint24 self) internal pure returns (uint16) {
 20 |     |         return uint16(self >> 12);
 21 |     |     }
 22 |     | 
 23 |     |     function isValidProtocolFee(uint24 self) internal pure returns (bool valid) {
 24 |     |         // Equivalent to: getZeroForOneFee(self) <= MAX_PROTOCOL_FEE && getOneForZeroFee(self) <= MAX_PROTOCOL_FEE
 25 |     |         assembly {
 26 |     |             let isZeroForOneFeeOk := lt(and(self, 0xfff), FEE_0_THRESHOLD)
 27 |     |             let isOneForZeroFeeOk := lt(self, FEE_1_THRESHOLD)
 28 |     |             valid := and(isZeroForOneFeeOk, isOneForZeroFeeOk)
 29 |     |         }
 30 |     |     }
 31 |     | 
 32 |     |     // The protocol fee is taken from the input amount first and then the LP fee is taken from the remaining
 33 |     |     // The swap fee is capped at 100%
 34 |     |     // Equivalent to protocolFee + lpFee(1_000_000 - protocolFee) / 1_000_000
 35 |     |     function calculateSwapFee(uint24 self, uint24 lpFee) internal pure returns (uint24 swapFee) {
 36 |     |         // protocolFee + lpFee - (protocolFee * lpFee / 1_000_000). Div rounds up to favor LPs over the protocol.
 37 |     |         assembly {
 38 |     |             let numerator := mul(self, lpFee)
 39 |     |             let divRoundingUp := add(div(numerator, PIPS_DENOMINATOR), gt(mod(numerator, PIPS_DENOMINATOR), 0))
 40 |     |             swapFee := sub(add(self, lpFee), divRoundingUp)
 41 |     |         }
 42 |     |     }
 43 |     | }
 44 |     |

 12 |     |     /// @notice The transient reserves for pools with no balance is set to the max as a sentinel to track that it has been synced.
 13 |     |     uint256 public constant ZERO_BALANCE = type(uint256).max;
 14 |     | 
 15 |     |     /// @notice Thrown when someone has not called sync before calling settle for the first time.
 16 |     |     error ReservesMustBeSynced();
 17 |     | 
 18 |     |     function setReserves(Currency currency, uint256 value) internal {
 19 |     |         if (value == 0) value = ZERO_BALANCE;
 20 |     |         bytes32 key = _getKey(currency);
 21 |     |         assembly {
 22 |     |             tstore(key, value)
 23 |     |         }
 24 |     |     }
 25 |     | 
 26 |     |     function getReserves(Currency currency) internal view returns (uint256 value) {
 27 |     |         bytes32 key = _getKey(currency);
 28 |     |         assembly {
 29 |     |             value := tload(key)
 30 |     |         }
 31 |     |         if (value == 0) ReservesMustBeSynced.selector.revertWith();
 32 |     |         if (value == ZERO_BALANCE) value = 0;
 33 |     |     }
 34 |     | 
 35 |     |     function _getKey(Currency currency) private pure returns (bytes32 key) {
 36 |     |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
 37 |     |             mstore(0, RESERVES_OF_SLOT)

 39 |     |             key := keccak256(0, 64)
 40 |     |         }

  1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
  2 |     | pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

  4 |     | /// @title Safe casting methods
  5 |     | /// @notice Contains methods for safely casting between types
  6 |     | library SafeCast {
  7 |     |     error SafeCastOverflow();
  8 |     | 
  9 |     |     function _revertOverflow() private pure {
 10 |     |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
 11 |     |             // Store the function selector of `SafeCastOverflow()`.
 12 |     |             mstore(0x00, 0x93dafdf1)
 13 |     |             // Revert with (offset, size).
 14 |     |             revert(0x1c, 0x04)
 15 |     |         }
 16 |     |     }
 17 |     | 
 18 |     |     /// @notice Cast a uint256 to a uint160, revert on overflow
 19 |     |     /// @param x The uint256 to be downcasted
 20 |     |     /// @return The downcasted integer, now type uint160
 21 |     |     function toUint160(uint256 x) internal pure returns (uint160) {
 22 |     |         if (x >= 1 << 160) _revertOverflow();
 23 |     |         return uint160(x);
 24 |     |     }
 25 |     | 
 26 |     |     /// @notice Cast a uint256 to a uint128, revert on overflow
 27 |     |     /// @param x The uint256 to be downcasted
 28 |     |     /// @return The downcasted integer, now type uint128
 29 |     |     function toUint128(uint256 x) internal pure returns (uint128) {
 30 |     |         if (x >= 1 << 128) _revertOverflow();
 31 |     |         return uint128(x);
 32 |     |     }
 33 |     | 
 34 |     |     /// @notice Cast a int256 to a int128, revert on overflow or underflow
 35 |     |     /// @param x The int256 to be downcasted
 36 |     |     /// @return The downcasted integer, now type int128
 37 |     |     function toInt128(int256 x) internal pure returns (int128) {
 38 |     |         unchecked {
 39 |     |             if (((1 << 127) + uint256(x)) >> 128 == uint256(0)) return int128(x);
 40 |     |             _revertOverflow();
 41 |     |         }
 42 |     |     }
 43 |     | 
 44 |     |     /// @notice Cast a uint256 to a int256, revert on overflow
 45 |     |     /// @param x The uint256 to be casted
 46 |     |     /// @return The casted integer, now type int256
 47 |     |     function toInt256(uint256 x) internal pure returns (int256) {
 48 |     |         if (int256(x) >= 0) return int256(x);
 49 |     |         _revertOverflow();
 50 |     |     }
 51 |     | 
 52 |     |     /// @notice Cast a uint256 to a int128, revert on overflow
 53 |     |     /// @param x The uint256 to be downcasted
 54 |     |     /// @return The downcasted integer, now type int128
 55 |     |     function toInt128(uint256 x) internal pure returns (int128) {
 56 |     |         if (x >= 1 << 127) _revertOverflow();
 57 |     |         return int128(int256(x));
 58 |     |     }

  10 |     | /// @title Functions based on Q64.96 sqrt price and liquidity
  11 |     | /// @notice Contains the math that uses square root of price as a Q64.96 and liquidity to compute deltas
  12 |     | library SqrtPriceMath {
  13 |     |     using SafeCast for uint256;
  14 |     | 
  15 |     |     error InvalidPriceOrLiquidity();
  16 |     |     error InvalidPrice();
  17 |     |     error NotEnoughLiquidity();
  18 |     |     error PriceOverflow();
  19 |     | 
  20 |     |     /// @notice Gets the next sqrt price given a delta of currency0
  21 |     |     /// @dev Always rounds up, because in the exact output case (increasing price) we need to move the price at least
  22 |     |     /// far enough to get the desired output amount, and in the exact input case (decreasing price) we need to move the
  23 |     |     /// price less in order to not send too much output.
  24 |     |     /// The most precise formula for this is liquidity * sqrtPX96 / (liquidity +- amount * sqrtPX96),
  25 |     |     /// if this is impossible because of overflow, we calculate liquidity / (liquidity / sqrtPX96 +- amount).
  26 |     |     /// @param sqrtPX96 The starting price, i.e. before accounting for the currency0 delta
  27 |     |     /// @param liquidity The amount of usable liquidity
  28 |     |     /// @param amount How much of currency0 to add or remove from virtual reserves
  29 |     |     /// @param add Whether to add or remove the amount of currency0
  30 |     |     /// @return The price after adding or removing amount, depending on add
  31 |     |     function getNextSqrtPriceFromAmount0RoundingUp(uint160 sqrtPX96, uint128 liquidity, uint256 amount, bool add)
  32 |     |         internal
  33 |     |         pure
  34 |     |         returns (uint160)
  35 |     |     {
  36 |     |         // we short circuit amount == 0 because the result is otherwise not guaranteed to equal the input price
  37 |     |         if (amount == 0) return sqrtPX96;
  38 |     |         uint256 numerator1 = uint256(liquidity) << FixedPoint96.RESOLUTION;
  39 |     | 
  40 |     |         if (add) {
  41 |     |             unchecked {
  42 |     |                 uint256 product = amount * sqrtPX96;
  43 |     |                 if (product / amount == sqrtPX96) {
  44 |     |                     uint256 denominator = numerator1 + product;
  45 |     |                     if (denominator >= numerator1) {
  46 |     |                         // always fits in 160 bits
  47 |     |                         return uint160(FullMath.mulDivRoundingUp(numerator1, sqrtPX96, denominator));
  48 |     |                     }
  49 |     |                 }
  50 |     |             }
  51 |     |             // denominator is checked for overflow
  52 |     |             return uint160(UnsafeMath.divRoundingUp(numerator1, (numerator1 / sqrtPX96) + amount));
  53 |     |         } else {
  54 |     |             unchecked {
  55 |     |                 uint256 product = amount * sqrtPX96;
  56 |     |                 // if the product overflows, we know the denominator underflows
  57 |     |                 // in addition, we must check that the denominator does not underflow
  58 |     |                 // equivalent: if (product / amount != sqrtPX96 || numerator1 <= product) revert PriceOverflow();
  59 |     |                 assembly ("memory-safe") {
  60 |     |                     if iszero(and(eq(div(product, amount), sqrtPX96), gt(numerator1, product))) {
  61 |     |                         mstore(0, 0xf5c787f1) // selector for PriceOverflow()
  62 |     |                         revert(0x1c, 0x04)
  63 |     |                     }
  64 |     |                 }
  65 |     |                 uint256 denominator = numerator1 - product;
  66 |     |                 return FullMath.mulDivRoundingUp(numerator1, sqrtPX96, denominator).toUint160();
  67 |     |             }
  68 |     |         }
  69 |     |     }
  70 |     | 
  71 |     |     /// @notice Gets the next sqrt price given a delta of currency1
  72 |     |     /// @dev Always rounds down, because in the exact output case (decreasing price) we need to move the price at least
  73 |     |     /// far enough to get the desired output amount, and in the exact input case (increasing price) we need to move the
  74 |     |     /// price less in order to not send too much output.
  75 |     |     /// The formula we compute is within <1 wei of the lossless version: sqrtPX96 +- amount / liquidity
  76 |     |     /// @param sqrtPX96 The starting price, i.e., before accounting for the currency1 delta
  77 |     |     /// @param liquidity The amount of usable liquidity
  78 |     |     /// @param amount How much of currency1 to add, or remove, from virtual reserves
  79 |     |     /// @param add Whether to add, or remove, the amount of currency1
  80 |     |     /// @return The price after adding or removing `amount`
  81 |     |     function getNextSqrtPriceFromAmount1RoundingDown(uint160 sqrtPX96, uint128 liquidity, uint256 amount, bool add)
  82 |     |         internal
  83 |     |         pure
  84 |     |         returns (uint160)
  85 |     |     {
  86 |     |         // if we're adding (subtracting), rounding down requires rounding the quotient down (up)
  87 |     |         // in both cases, avoid a mulDiv for most inputs
  88 |     |         if (add) {
  89 |     |             uint256 quotient = (
  90 |     |                 amount <= type(uint160).max
  91 |     |                     ? (amount << FixedPoint96.RESOLUTION) / liquidity
  92 |     |                     : FullMath.mulDiv(amount, FixedPoint96.Q96, liquidity)
  93 |     |             );
  94 |     | 
  95 |     |             return (uint256(sqrtPX96) + quotient).toUint160();
  96 |     |         } else {
  97 |     |             uint256 quotient = (
  98 |     |                 amount <= type(uint160).max
  99 |     |                     ? UnsafeMath.divRoundingUp(amount << FixedPoint96.RESOLUTION, liquidity)
 100 |     |                     : FullMath.mulDivRoundingUp(amount, FixedPoint96.Q96, liquidity)
 101 |     |             );
 102 |     | 
 103 |     |             // equivalent: if (sqrtPX96 <= quotient) revert NotEnoughLiquidity();
 104 |     |             assembly ("memory-safe") {
 105 |     |                 if iszero(gt(sqrtPX96, quotient)) {
 106 |     |                     mstore(0, 0x4323a555) // selector for NotEnoughLiquidity()
 107 |     |                     revert(0x1c, 0x04)
 108 |     |                 }
 109 |     |             }
 110 |     |             // always fits 160 bits
 111 |     |             unchecked {
 112 |     |                 return uint160(sqrtPX96 - quotient);
 113 |     |             }
 114 |     |         }
 115 |     |     }
 116 |     | 
 117 |     |     /// @notice Gets the next sqrt price given an input amount of currency0 or currency1
 118 |     |     /// @dev Throws if price or liquidity are 0, or if the next price is out of bounds
 119 |     |     /// @param sqrtPX96 The starting price, i.e., before accounting for the input amount
 120 |     |     /// @param liquidity The amount of usable liquidity
 121 |     |     /// @param amountIn How much of currency0, or currency1, is being swapped in
 122 |     |     /// @param zeroForOne Whether the amount in is currency0 or currency1
 123 |     |     /// @return sqrtQX96 The price after adding the input amount to currency0 or currency1
 124 |     |     function getNextSqrtPriceFromInput(uint160 sqrtPX96, uint128 liquidity, uint256 amountIn, bool zeroForOne)
 125 |     |         internal
 126 |     |         pure
 127 |     |         returns (uint160 sqrtQX96)
 128 |     |     {
 129 |     |         // equivalent: if (sqrtPX96 == 0 || liquidity == 0) revert InvalidPriceOrLiquidity();
 130 |     |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
 131 |     |             if or(iszero(sqrtPX96), iszero(liquidity)) {
 132 |     |                 mstore(0, 0x4f2461b8) // selector for InvalidPriceOrLiquidity()
 133 |     |                 revert(0x1c, 0x04)
 134 |     |             }
 135 |     |         }
 136 |     | 
 137 |     |         // round to make sure that we don't pass the target price
 138 |     |         return zeroForOne
 139 |     |             ? getNextSqrtPriceFromAmount0RoundingUp(sqrtPX96, liquidity, amountIn, true)
 140 |     |             : getNextSqrtPriceFromAmount1RoundingDown(sqrtPX96, liquidity, amountIn, true);
 141 |     |     }
 142 |     | 
 143 |     |     /// @notice Gets the next sqrt price given an output amount of currency0 or currency1
 144 |     |     /// @dev Throws if price or liquidity are 0 or the next price is out of bounds
 145 |     |     /// @param sqrtPX96 The starting price before accounting for the output amount
 146 |     |     /// @param liquidity The amount of usable liquidity
 147 |     |     /// @param amountOut How much of currency0, or currency1, is being swapped out
 148 |     |     /// @param zeroForOne Whether the amount out is currency1 or currency0
 149 |     |     /// @return sqrtQX96 The price after removing the output amount of currency0 or currency1
 150 |     |     function getNextSqrtPriceFromOutput(uint160 sqrtPX96, uint128 liquidity, uint256 amountOut, bool zeroForOne)
 151 |     |         internal
 152 |     |         pure
 153 |     |         returns (uint160 sqrtQX96)
 154 |     |     {
 155 |     |         // equivalent: if (sqrtPX96 == 0 || liquidity == 0) revert InvalidPriceOrLiquidity();
 156 |     |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
 157 |     |             if or(iszero(sqrtPX96), iszero(liquidity)) {
 158 |     |                 mstore(0, 0x4f2461b8) // selector for InvalidPriceOrLiquidity()
 159 |     |                 revert(0x1c, 0x04)
 160 |     |             }
 161 |     |         }
 162 |     | 
 163 |     |         // round to make sure that we pass the target price
 164 |     |         return zeroForOne
 165 |     |             ? getNextSqrtPriceFromAmount1RoundingDown(sqrtPX96, liquidity, amountOut, false)
 166 |     |             : getNextSqrtPriceFromAmount0RoundingUp(sqrtPX96, liquidity, amountOut, false);
 167 |     |     }

 169 |     |     /// @notice Gets the amount0 delta between two prices
 170 |     |     /// @dev Calculates liquidity / sqrt(lower) - liquidity / sqrt(upper),
 171 |     |     /// i.e. liquidity * (sqrt(upper) - sqrt(lower)) / (sqrt(upper) * sqrt(lower))
 172 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceAX96 A sqrt price
 173 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceBX96 Another sqrt price
 174 |     |     /// @param liquidity The amount of usable liquidity
 175 |     |     /// @param roundUp Whether to round the amount up or down
 176 |     |     /// @return amount0 Amount of currency0 required to cover a position of size liquidity between the two passed prices
 177 |     |     function getAmount0Delta(uint160 sqrtPriceAX96, uint160 sqrtPriceBX96, uint128 liquidity, bool roundUp)
 178 |     |         internal
 179 |     |         pure
 180 |     |         returns (uint256 amount0)
 181 |     |     {
 182 |     |         unchecked {
 183 |     |             if (sqrtPriceAX96 > sqrtPriceBX96) (sqrtPriceAX96, sqrtPriceBX96) = (sqrtPriceBX96, sqrtPriceAX96);
 184 |     | 
 185 |     |             // equivalent: if (sqrtPriceAX96 == 0) revert InvalidPrice();
 186 |     |             assembly ("memory-safe") {
 187 |     |                 if iszero(sqrtPriceAX96) {
 188 |     |                     mstore(0, 0x00bfc921) // selector for InvalidPrice()
 189 |     |                     revert(0x1c, 0x04)
 190 |     |                 }
 191 |     |             }
 192 |     | 
 193 |     |             uint256 numerator1 = uint256(liquidity) << FixedPoint96.RESOLUTION;
 194 |     |             uint256 numerator2 = sqrtPriceBX96 - sqrtPriceAX96;
 195 |     | 
 196 |     |             return roundUp
 197 |     |                 ? UnsafeMath.divRoundingUp(FullMath.mulDivRoundingUp(numerator1, numerator2, sqrtPriceBX96), sqrtPriceAX96)
 198 |     |                 : FullMath.mulDiv(numerator1, numerator2, sqrtPriceBX96) / sqrtPriceAX96;
 199 |     |         }
 200 |     |     }
 201 |     | 
 202 |     |     /// @notice Equivalent to: `a >= b ? a - b : b - a`
 203 |     |     function absDiff(uint160 a, uint160 b) internal pure returns (uint256 res) {
 204 |     |         assembly {
 205 |     |             let diff := sub(a, b)
 206 |     |             // mask = 0 if a >= b else -1 (all 1s)
 207 |     |             let mask := sar(255, diff)
 208 |     |             // if a >= b, res = a - b = 0 ^ (a - b)
 209 |     |             // if a < b, res = b - a = ~~(b - a) = ~(-(b - a) - 1) = ~(a - b - 1) = (-1) ^ (a - b - 1)
 210 |     |             // either way, res = mask ^ (a - b + mask)
 211 |     |             res := xor(mask, add(mask, diff))
 212 |     |         }
 213 |     |     }
 214 |     | 
 215 |     |     /// @notice Gets the amount1 delta between two prices
 216 |     |     /// @dev Calculates liquidity * (sqrt(upper) - sqrt(lower))
 217 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceAX96 A sqrt price
 218 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceBX96 Another sqrt price
 219 |     |     /// @param liquidity The amount of usable liquidity
 220 |     |     /// @param roundUp Whether to round the amount up, or down
 221 |     |     /// @return amount1 Amount of currency1 required to cover a position of size liquidity between the two passed prices
 222 |     |     function getAmount1Delta(uint160 sqrtPriceAX96, uint160 sqrtPriceBX96, uint128 liquidity, bool roundUp)
 223 |     |         internal
 224 |     |         pure
 225 |     |         returns (uint256 amount1)
 226 |     |     {
 227 |     |         uint256 numerator = absDiff(sqrtPriceAX96, sqrtPriceBX96);
 228 |     |         uint256 denominator = FixedPoint96.Q96;
 229 |     |         uint256 _liquidity;
 230 |     |         assembly {
 231 |     |             // avoid implicit upcasting
 232 |     |             _liquidity := liquidity
 233 |     |         }
 234 |     |         /**
 235 |     |          * Equivalent to:
 236 |     |          *   amount1 = roundUp
 237 |     |          *       ? FullMath.mulDivRoundingUp(liquidity, sqrtPriceBX96 - sqrtPriceAX96, FixedPoint96.Q96)
 238 |     |          *       : FullMath.mulDiv(liquidity, sqrtPriceBX96 - sqrtPriceAX96, FixedPoint96.Q96);
 239 |     |          * Cannot overflow because `type(uint128).max * type(uint160).max >> 96 < (1 << 192)`.
 240 |     |          */
 241 |     |         amount1 = FullMath.mulDiv(_liquidity, numerator, denominator);
 242 |     |         assembly {
 243 |     |             amount1 := add(amount1, and(gt(mulmod(_liquidity, numerator, denominator), 0), roundUp))
 244 |     |         }
 245 |     |     }
 246 |     | 
 247 |     |     /// @notice Helper that gets signed currency0 delta
 248 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceAX96 A sqrt price
 249 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceBX96 Another sqrt price
 250 |     |     /// @param liquidity The change in liquidity for which to compute the amount0 delta
 251 |     |     /// @return amount0 Amount of currency0 corresponding to the passed liquidityDelta between the two prices
 252 |     |     function getAmount0Delta(uint160 sqrtPriceAX96, uint160 sqrtPriceBX96, int128 liquidity)
 253 |     |         internal
 254 |     |         pure
 255 |     |         returns (int256 amount0)
 256 |     |     {
 257 |     |         unchecked {
 258 |     |             return liquidity < 0
 259 |     |                 ? getAmount0Delta(sqrtPriceAX96, sqrtPriceBX96, uint128(-liquidity), false).toInt256()
 260 |     |                 : -getAmount0Delta(sqrtPriceAX96, sqrtPriceBX96, uint128(liquidity), true).toInt256();
 261 |     |         }
 262 |     |     }
 263 |     | 
 264 |     |     /// @notice Helper that gets signed currency1 delta
 265 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceAX96 A sqrt price
 266 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceBX96 Another sqrt price
 267 |     |     /// @param liquidity The change in liquidity for which to compute the amount1 delta
 268 |     |     /// @return amount1 Amount of currency1 corresponding to the passed liquidityDelta between the two prices
 269 |     |     function getAmount1Delta(uint160 sqrtPriceAX96, uint160 sqrtPriceBX96, int128 liquidity)
 270 |     |         internal
 271 |     |         pure
 272 |     |         returns (int256 amount1)
 273 |     |     {
 274 |     |         unchecked {
 275 |     |             return liquidity < 0
 276 |     |                 ? getAmount1Delta(sqrtPriceAX96, sqrtPriceBX96, uint128(-liquidity), false).toInt256()
 277 |     |                 : -getAmount1Delta(sqrtPriceAX96, sqrtPriceBX96, uint128(liquidity), true).toInt256();
 278 |     |         }
 279 |     |     }

 290 |     |     /**
 291 |     |      * @notice Live calculate the fee growth inside a tick range of a pool
 292 |     |      * @dev pools[poolId].feeGrowthInside0LastX128 in Position.Info is cached and can become stale. This function will live calculate the feeGrowthInside
 293 |     |      * @param manager The pool manager contract.
 294 |     |      * @param poolId The ID of the pool.
 295 |     |      * @param tickLower The lower tick of the range.
 296 |     |      * @param tickUpper The upper tick of the range.
 297 |     |      * @return feeGrowthInside0X128 The fee growth inside the tick range for token0.
 298 |     |      * @return feeGrowthInside1X128 The fee growth inside the tick range for token1.
 299 |     |      */
 300 |     |     function getFeeGrowthInside(IPoolManager manager, PoolId poolId, int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper)
 301 |     |         internal
 302 |     |         view
 303 |     |         returns (uint256 feeGrowthInside0X128, uint256 feeGrowthInside1X128)
 304 |     |     {
 305 |     |         (uint256 feeGrowthGlobal0X128, uint256 feeGrowthGlobal1X128) = getFeeGrowthGlobals(manager, poolId);
 306 |     | 
 307 |     |         (uint256 lowerFeeGrowthOutside0X128, uint256 lowerFeeGrowthOutside1X128) =
 308 |     |             getTickFeeGrowthOutside(manager, poolId, tickLower);
 309 |     |         (uint256 upperFeeGrowthOutside0X128, uint256 upperFeeGrowthOutside1X128) =
 310 |     |             getTickFeeGrowthOutside(manager, poolId, tickUpper);
 311 |     |         (, int24 tickCurrent,,) = getSlot0(manager, poolId);
 312 |     |         unchecked {
 313 |     |             if (tickCurrent < tickLower) {
 314 |     |                 feeGrowthInside0X128 = lowerFeeGrowthOutside0X128 - upperFeeGrowthOutside0X128;
 315 |     |                 feeGrowthInside1X128 = lowerFeeGrowthOutside1X128 - upperFeeGrowthOutside1X128;
 316 |     |             } else if (tickCurrent >= tickUpper) {
 317 |     |                 feeGrowthInside0X128 = upperFeeGrowthOutside0X128 - lowerFeeGrowthOutside0X128;
 318 |     |                 feeGrowthInside1X128 = upperFeeGrowthOutside1X128 - lowerFeeGrowthOutside1X128;
 319 |     |             } else {
 320 |     |                 feeGrowthInside0X128 = feeGrowthGlobal0X128 - lowerFeeGrowthOutside0X128 - upperFeeGrowthOutside0X128;
 321 |     |                 feeGrowthInside1X128 = feeGrowthGlobal1X128 - lowerFeeGrowthOutside1X128 - upperFeeGrowthOutside1X128;
 322 |     |             }
 323 |     |         }
 324 |     |     }

   4 |     | import {FullMath} from "./FullMath.sol";

   7 |     | /// @title Computes the result of a swap within ticks
   8 |     | /// @notice Contains methods for computing the result of a swap within a single tick price range, i.e., a single tick.
   9 |     | library SwapMath {
  10 |     |     uint256 internal constant MAX_FEE_PIPS = 1e6;
  11 |     | 
  12 |     |     /// @notice Computes the sqrt price target for the next swap step
  13 |     |     /// @param zeroForOne The direction of the swap, true for currency0 to currency1, false for currency1 to currency0
  14 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceNextX96 The Q64.96 sqrt price for the next initialized tick
  15 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceLimitX96 The Q64.96 sqrt price limit. If zero for one, the price cannot be less than this value
  16 |     |     /// after the swap. If one for zero, the price cannot be greater than this value after the swap
  17 |     |     /// @return sqrtPriceTargetX96 The price target for the next swap step
  18 |     |     function getSqrtPriceTarget(bool zeroForOne, uint160 sqrtPriceNextX96, uint160 sqrtPriceLimitX96)
  19 |     |         internal
  20 |     |         pure
  21 |     |         returns (uint160 sqrtPriceTargetX96)
  22 |     |     {
  23 |     |         assembly {
  24 |     |             // a flag to toggle between sqrtPriceNextX96 and sqrtPriceLimitX96
  25 |     |             // when zeroForOne == true, nextOrLimit reduces to sqrtPriceNextX96 >= sqrtPriceLimitX96
  26 |     |             // sqrtPriceTargetX96 = max(sqrtPriceNextX96, sqrtPriceLimitX96)
  27 |     |             // when zeroForOne == false, nextOrLimit reduces to sqrtPriceNextX96 < sqrtPriceLimitX96
  28 |     |             // sqrtPriceTargetX96 = min(sqrtPriceNextX96, sqrtPriceLimitX96)
  29 |     |             let nextOrLimit := xor(lt(sqrtPriceNextX96, sqrtPriceLimitX96), zeroForOne)
  30 |     |             let symDiff := xor(sqrtPriceNextX96, sqrtPriceLimitX96)
  31 |     |             sqrtPriceTargetX96 := xor(sqrtPriceLimitX96, mul(symDiff, nextOrLimit))
  32 |     |         }
  33 |     |     }
  34 |     | 
  35 |     |     /// @notice Computes the result of swapping some amount in, or amount out, given the parameters of the swap
  36 |     |     /// @dev If the swap's amountSpecified is negative, the combined fee and input amount will never exceed the absolute value of the remaining amount.
  37 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceCurrentX96 The current sqrt price of the pool
  38 |     |     /// @param sqrtPriceTargetX96 The price that cannot be exceeded, from which the direction of the swap is inferred
  39 |     |     /// @param liquidity The usable liquidity
  40 |     |     /// @param amountRemaining How much input or output amount is remaining to be swapped in/out
  41 |     |     /// @param feePips The fee taken from the input amount, expressed in hundredths of a bip
  42 |     |     /// @return sqrtPriceNextX96 The price after swapping the amount in/out, not to exceed the price target
  43 |     |     /// @return amountIn The amount to be swapped in, of either currency0 or currency1, based on the direction of the swap
  44 |     |     /// @return amountOut The amount to be received, of either currency0 or currency1, based on the direction of the swap
  45 |     |     /// @return feeAmount The amount of input that will be taken as a fee
  46 |     |     function computeSwapStep(
  47 |     |         uint160 sqrtPriceCurrentX96,
  48 |     |         uint160 sqrtPriceTargetX96,
  49 |     |         uint128 liquidity,
  50 |     |         int256 amountRemaining,
  51 |     |         uint24 feePips
  52 |     |     ) internal pure returns (uint160 sqrtPriceNextX96, uint256 amountIn, uint256 amountOut, uint256 feeAmount) {
  53 |     |         unchecked {
  54 |     |             uint256 _feePips = feePips; // upcast once and cache
  55 |     |             bool zeroForOne = sqrtPriceCurrentX96 >= sqrtPriceTargetX96;
  56 |     |             bool exactIn = amountRemaining < 0;
  57 |     | 
  58 |     |             if (exactIn) {
  59 |     |                 uint256 amountRemainingLessFee =
  60 |     |                     FullMath.mulDiv(uint256(-amountRemaining), MAX_FEE_PIPS - _feePips, MAX_FEE_PIPS);
  61 |     |                 amountIn = zeroForOne
  62 |     |                     ? SqrtPriceMath.getAmount0Delta(sqrtPriceTargetX96, sqrtPriceCurrentX96, liquidity, true)
  63 |     |                     : SqrtPriceMath.getAmount1Delta(sqrtPriceCurrentX96, sqrtPriceTargetX96, liquidity, true);
  64 |     |                 if (amountRemainingLessFee >= amountIn) {
  65 |     |                     // `amountIn` is capped by the target price
  66 |     |                     sqrtPriceNextX96 = sqrtPriceTargetX96;
  67 |     |                     feeAmount = _feePips == MAX_FEE_PIPS
  68 |     |                         ? amountIn
  69 |     |                         : FullMath.mulDivRoundingUp(amountIn, _feePips, MAX_FEE_PIPS - _feePips);
  70 |     |                 } else {
  71 |     |                     sqrtPriceNextX96 = SqrtPriceMath.getNextSqrtPriceFromInput(
  72 |     |                         sqrtPriceCurrentX96, liquidity, amountRemainingLessFee, zeroForOne
  73 |     |                     );
  74 |     |                     amountIn = zeroForOne
  75 |     |                         ? SqrtPriceMath.getAmount0Delta(sqrtPriceNextX96, sqrtPriceCurrentX96, liquidity, true)
  76 |     |                         : SqrtPriceMath.getAmount1Delta(sqrtPriceCurrentX96, sqrtPriceNextX96, liquidity, true);
  77 |     |                     // we didn't reach the target, so take the remainder of the maximum input as fee
  78 |     |                     feeAmount = uint256(-amountRemaining) - amountIn;
  79 |     |                 }
  80 |     |                 amountOut = zeroForOne
  81 |     |                     ? SqrtPriceMath.getAmount1Delta(sqrtPriceNextX96, sqrtPriceCurrentX96, liquidity, false)
  82 |     |                     : SqrtPriceMath.getAmount0Delta(sqrtPriceCurrentX96, sqrtPriceNextX96, liquidity, false);
  83 |     |             } else {
  84 |     |                 amountOut = zeroForOne
  85 |     |                     ? SqrtPriceMath.getAmount1Delta(sqrtPriceTargetX96, sqrtPriceCurrentX96, liquidity, false)
  86 |     |                     : SqrtPriceMath.getAmount0Delta(sqrtPriceCurrentX96, sqrtPriceTargetX96, liquidity, false);
  87 |     |                 if (uint256(amountRemaining) >= amountOut) {
  88 |     |                     // `amountOut` is capped by the target price
  89 |     |                     sqrtPriceNextX96 = sqrtPriceTargetX96;
  90 |     |                 } else {
  91 |     |                     // cap the output amount to not exceed the remaining output amount
  92 |     |                     amountOut = uint256(amountRemaining);
  93 |     |                     sqrtPriceNextX96 =
  94 |     |                         SqrtPriceMath.getNextSqrtPriceFromOutput(sqrtPriceCurrentX96, liquidity, amountOut, zeroForOne);
  95 |     |                 }
  96 |     |                 amountIn = zeroForOne
  97 |     |                     ? SqrtPriceMath.getAmount0Delta(sqrtPriceNextX96, sqrtPriceCurrentX96, liquidity, true)
  98 |     |                     : SqrtPriceMath.getAmount1Delta(sqrtPriceCurrentX96, sqrtPriceNextX96, liquidity, true);
  99 |     |                 // `feePips` cannot be `MAX_FEE_PIPS` for exact out
 100 |     |                 feeAmount = FullMath.mulDivRoundingUp(amountIn, _feePips, MAX_FEE_PIPS - _feePips);
 101 |     |             }
 102 |     |         }
 103 |     |     }
 104 |     | }

   1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
   2 |     | pragma solidity ^0.8.20;
   3 |     | 
   4 |     | import {BitMath} from "./BitMath.sol";
   5 |     | 
   6 |     | /// @title Packed tick initialized state library
   7 |     | /// @notice Stores a packed mapping of tick index to its initialized state
   8 |     | /// @dev The mapping uses int16 for keys since ticks are represented as int24 and there are 256 (2^8) values per word.
   9 |     | library TickBitmap {
  10 |     |     /// @notice Thrown when the tick is not enumerated by the tick spacing
  11 |     |     /// @param tick the invalid tick
  12 |     |     /// @param tickSpacing The tick spacing of the pool
  13 |     |     error TickMisaligned(int24 tick, int24 tickSpacing);
  14 |     | 
  15 |     |     /// @dev round towards negative infinity
  16 |     |     function compress(int24 tick, int24 tickSpacing) internal pure returns (int24 compressed) {
  17 |     |         // compressed = tick / tickSpacing;
  18 |     |         // if (tick < 0 && tick % tickSpacing != 0) compressed--;
  19 |     |         assembly {
  20 |     |             compressed :=
  21 |     |                 sub(
  22 |     |                     sdiv(tick, tickSpacing),
  23 |     |                     // if (tick < 0 && tick % tickSpacing != 0) then tick % tickSpacing < 0, vice versa
  24 |     |                     slt(smod(tick, tickSpacing), 0)
  25 |     |                 )
  26 |     |         }
  27 |     |     }
  28 |     | 
  29 |     |     /// @notice Computes the position in the mapping where the initialized bit for a tick lives
  30 |     |     /// @param tick The tick for which to compute the position
  31 |     |     /// @return wordPos The key in the mapping containing the word in which the bit is stored
  32 |     |     /// @return bitPos The bit position in the word where the flag is stored
  33 |     |     function position(int24 tick) internal pure returns (int16 wordPos, uint8 bitPos) {
  34 |     |         assembly {
  35 |     |             // signed arithmetic shift right
  36 |     |             wordPos := sar(8, tick)
  37 |     |             bitPos := and(tick, 0xff)
  38 |     |         }
  39 |     |     }
  40 |     | 
  41 |     |     /// @notice Flips the initialized state for a given tick from false to true, or vice versa
  42 |     |     /// @param self The mapping in which to flip the tick
  43 |     |     /// @param tick The tick to flip
  44 |     |     /// @param tickSpacing The spacing between usable ticks
  45 |     |     function flipTick(mapping(int16 => uint256) storage self, int24 tick, int24 tickSpacing) internal {
  46 |     |         // Equivalent to the following Solidity:
  47 |     |         //     if (tick % tickSpacing != 0) revert TickMisaligned(tick, tickSpacing);
  48 |     |         //     (int16 wordPos, uint8 bitPos) = position(tick / tickSpacing);
  49 |     |         //     uint256 mask = 1 << bitPos;
  50 |     |         //     self[wordPos] ^= mask;
  51 |     |         assembly ("memory-safe") {
  52 |     |             // ensure that the tick is spaced
  53 |     |             if smod(tick, tickSpacing) {
  54 |     |                 mstore(0, 0xd4d8f3e6) // selector for TickMisaligned(int24,int24)
  55 |     |                 mstore(0x20, tick)
  56 |     |                 mstore(0x40, tickSpacing)
  57 |     |                 revert(0x1c, 0x44)
  58 |     |             }
  59 |     |             tick := sdiv(tick, tickSpacing)
  60 |     |             // calculate the storage slot corresponding to the tick
  61 |     |             // wordPos = tick >> 8
  62 |     |             mstore(0, sar(8, tick))
  63 |     |             mstore(0x20, self.slot)
  64 |     |             // the slot of self[wordPos] is keccak256(abi.encode(wordPos, self.slot))
  65 |     |             let slot := keccak256(0, 0x40)
  66 |     |             // mask = 1 << bitPos = 1 << (tick % 256)
  67 |     |             // self[wordPos] ^= mask
  68 |     |             sstore(slot, xor(sload(slot), shl(and(tick, 0xff), 1)))
  69 |     |         }
  70 |     |     }
  71 |     | 
  72 |     |     /// @notice Returns the next initialized tick contained in the same word (or adjacent word) as the tick that is either
  73 |     |     /// to the left (less than or equal to) or right (greater than) of the given tick
  74 |     |     /// @param self The mapping in which to compute the next initialized tick
  75 |     |     /// @param tick The starting tick
  76 |     |     /// @param tickSpacing The spacing between usable ticks
  77 |     |     /// @param lte Whether to search for the next initialized tick to the left (less than or equal to the starting tick)
  78 |     |     /// @return next The next initialized or uninitialized tick up to 256 ticks away from the current tick
  79 |     |     /// @return initialized Whether the next tick is initialized, as the function only searches within up to 256 ticks
  80 |     |     function nextInitializedTickWithinOneWord(
  81 |     |         mapping(int16 => uint256) storage self,
  82 |     |         int24 tick,
  83 |     |         int24 tickSpacing,
  84 |     |         bool lte
  85 |     |     ) internal view returns (int24 next, bool initialized) {
  86 |     |         unchecked {
  87 |     |             int24 compressed = compress(tick, tickSpacing);
  88 |     | 
  89 |     |             if (lte) {
  90 |     |                 (int16 wordPos, uint8 bitPos) = position(compressed);
  91 |     |                 // all the 1s at or to the right of the current bitPos
  92 |     |                 uint256 mask = (1 << bitPos) - 1 + (1 << bitPos);
  93 |     |                 uint256 masked = self[wordPos] & mask;
  94 |     | 
  95 |     |                 // if there are no initialized ticks to the right of or at the current tick, return rightmost in the word
  96 |     |                 initialized = masked != 0;
  97 |     |                 // overflow/underflow is possible, but prevented externally by limiting both tickSpacing and tick
  98 |     |                 next = initialized
  99 |     |                     ? (compressed - int24(uint24(bitPos - BitMath.mostSignificantBit(masked)))) * tickSpacing
 100 |     |                     : (compressed - int24(uint24(bitPos))) * tickSpacing;
 101 |     |             } else {
 102 |     |                 // start from the word of the next tick, since the current tick state doesn't matter
 103 |     |                 (int16 wordPos, uint8 bitPos) = position(++compressed);
 104 |     |                 // all the 1s at or to the left of the bitPos
 105 |     |                 uint256 mask = ~((1 << bitPos) - 1);
 106 |     |                 uint256 masked = self[wordPos] & mask;
 107 |     | 
 108 |     |                 // if there are no initialized ticks to the left of the current tick, return leftmost in the word
 109 |     |                 initialized = masked != 0;
 110 |     |                 // overflow/underflow is possible, but prevented externally by limiting both tickSpacing and tick
 111 |     |                 next = initialized
 112 |     |                     ? (compressed + int24(uint24(BitMath.leastSignificantBit(masked) - bitPos))) * tickSpacing
 113 |     |                     : (compressed + int24(uint24(type(uint8).max - bitPos))) * tickSpacing;
 114 |     |             }
 115 |     |         }
 116 |     |     }
 117 |     | }
